stories.title: Pakistani Security Forces Dismantle Terrorist Hideouts Inside Mosques in North Waziristan
stories.summary:
Security forces in Pakistan successfully targeted and neutralised two terrorist hideouts situated within mosques in Muzak village, located on the southern fringes of Mir Ali in North Waziristan. The operation was executed by the military against elements linked to the Indian proxy Fitna-al Khwarij, according to an announcement by the Inter-Services Public Relations.

During the intelligence-based operation, military personnel sanitised the mosque hideouts and uncovered a large cache of prepared improvised explosive devices, explosive preparation materials, weapons, and ammunition. The military's media wing stated that the militants had deliberately utilized the places of worship to store explosives and operate torture cells, condemning the act as a reprehensible desecration that disregards fundamental Islamic teachings.

The ISPR further noted that these insurgents, whom they described as abetted by the Afghan Taliban, misuse religion in a manner entirely rejected by the citizens of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Pakistan. Brave soldiers are continuing sanitisation operations to eradicate any remaining foreign-sponsored terrorist networks under the Azm-e-Istehkam vision, aiming to wipe out the menace completely.

President Asif Ali Zardari lauded the security forces for executing the successful intelligence-based operation with high professionalism. He strongly condemned the misuse of mosques as violence centres and storage facilities for explosives, emphasizing that such actions represent a blatant violation of Islamic principles.

stories.title: Pakistan Mulls Splitting Into 12 Provinces Following 2029 General Elections
stories.summary:
Plans are under discussion in Pakistan to restructure the country's administrative map by increasing the number of provinces from four to 12. According to sources speaking to The News, the proposed changes could see Punjab divided into four units, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan into three each, and Sindh into two. Although constitutional legislation for the reform is under consideration for the coming year, actual implementation is expected to take place only after the 2029 general elections. Current provincial governments and assemblies will continue to function until that time.

The initiative aims to decentralize administration, but it faces significant financial, constitutional, and administrative hurdles. Three critical issues have emerged: the distribution of resources under the National Finance Commission (NFC) Award, the sharing of water resources, and the settlement of financial liabilities between the federal government and existing provinces.

The resource distribution challenge centers on how the federal divisible pool, currently allocated among four provinces based on factors like population and poverty, will be divided among 12 units. Similarly, water resource sharing, which is governed by the 1991 Water Apportionment Accord regarding the Indus River system, will require fresh understanding and revision to accommodate successor provinces. Finally, settling outstanding financial claims, loans, and liabilities requires a comprehensive assessment of each entity's fiscal position to avoid disputes.

These complex challenges necessitate extensive consultations among the federal government, existing provincial administrations, and other stakeholders. Resolving these sensitive economic and legal matters is crucial before the proposed constitutional restructuring can move forward toward formal implementation.

stories.title: Pakistan Leaders Call for Equality and National Unity on Iqbal Day
stories.summary:
President Asif Ali Zardari and Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif issued statements on Monday marking the 149th birth anniversary of national poet Dr Allama Iqbal. President Zardari stressed the need to ensure equality among all citizens, noting that Iqbal envisioned a society where individual worth is not determined by wealth, privilege, or inherited status. Zardari highlighted the poet's concepts of dignity, fair wages for workers, and khudi, urging the youth to utilize inquiry and critical faculties to strengthen the country.

Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif announced that the government is launching a year-long commemoration of Iqbal's 149th birth anniversary starting Monday, concluding on November 9 of next year. The premier stated that the comprehensive program will feature international conferences, academic seminars, literary festivals, and cultural activities to transmit Iqbal's intellectual legacy to future generations. He credited Iqbal with awakening political consciousness among the Muslims of the subcontinent, which was pivotal in the creation of an independent homeland.

The prime minister emphasized the government's commitment to integrating Iqbal's thought into educational institutions, national discourse, and development priorities. He noted that the concept of khudi teaches individuals and nations to transform their destinies through self-realization and purposeful endeavor. Guided by this vision, PM Shehbaz stated that Pakistan will continue to champion unity among the Muslim Ummah and support the peaceful resolution of international disputes.

The commemorative initiatives and leadership messages aim to foster creative thinking, strengthen national character, and turn the ideal of equality into everyday justice. Both leaders underscored the importance of national self-respect, independent decision-making, and engagement with other countries based on mutual respect.

stories.title: Rock Mass Collapse at Tarbela Dam 5th Extension Triggers Water Surge
stories.summary:
An emergency was declared at the Tarbela Dam 5th Extension Project construction site after a weak rock mass collapsed during excavation work, causing a surge of water to enter downstream work areas. The incident occurred during the excavation of the 2nd Bench Connecting Tunnel, allowing water from the Intake Pit to breach the tunnel and flow into the under-construction powerhouse area.

The Water and Power Development Authority stated that construction work was immediately suspended and all workers were safely evacuated to secure locations following the collapse. Officials confirmed that the water from the Intake Pit had been entirely drained, halting any further water entry into the downstream work sites, while dewatering operations at the under-construction powerhouse commenced promptly.

Senior Wapda officers, the project engineer, and the contractor gathered at the site to assess the situation and address potential challenges to the T-5 project. Authorities officially dismissed widespread rumors regarding the structural collapse of the main T-5 tunnel, reassuring the public that the main tunnel, power house, tailrace culvert, and switchyard sustained no structural damage.

Wapda also confirmed that the workforce suffered zero injuries or loss of life during the incident or the subsequent emergency evacuation. Dewatering and assessment efforts remain ongoing as project leaders evaluate the next steps for resuming construction safely.

stories.title: David Warner Confirms Full Australian Cricket Team Knew About 2018 Ball-Tampering
stories.summary:
Former Australian cricketer David Warner stated that remarks made by his former teammate Usman Khawaja regarding the 2018 ball-tampering scandal in South Africa were completely accurate. Khawaja had asserted in an autobiography excerpt that lighthearted discussions concerning the plan to rough up the ball with sandpaper at Newlands in Cape Town involved the entire team rather than just select batters, bowlers, or staff.

In an Instagram video, Warner thanked Khawaja and criticized Cricket Australia's original investigation into the incident as rushed and botched. Warner pointed out that player Cameron Bancroft was interviewed while Khawaja, who sat next to Bancroft, was never questioned, questioning the thoroughness of the inquiry. Warner emphasized that he and Khawaja are seeking accountability, transparency, and the proper examination of facts rather than reopening old wounds or pointing fingers.

Cricket Australia defended its 2018 probe, reiterating in a statement that prior knowledge of the plot was strictly confined to Steve Smith, Warner, and Bancroft, and that all relevant information presented has been properly reviewed. The four Australian bowlers who played in the fateful test—Pat Cummins, Josh Hazlewood, Mitchell Starc, and Nathan Lyon—previously issued a joint statement in 2021 denying any prior knowledge of the ball-tampering plot.

Warner, who retired from international cricket in 2024, expressed frustration over years of inaccurate media statements and silence from various individuals. Meanwhile, current Australian test captain Pat Cummins previously noted that he had discussed the upcoming book release with Khawaja and dismissed concerns that it would cause a major new fallout.

stories.title: Rawalpindi Court Grants Two-Day Physical Remand of Husband in TV Anchor's Killing
stories.summary:
A local court in Rawalpindi granted police a two-day physical remand of Ahsan, the husband of murdered anchorperson Rabia Ahsan. The victim was shot dead at her home in the Gulshanabad area, suffering a gunshot wound below her neck that was discovered by police on Sunday. Her husband was promptly taken into custody following a formal complaint filed by the victim's brother.

A first information report was registered at the Saddar Beruni police station under Section 302 of the Pakistan Penal Code for premeditated murder, alongside Section 2-A of the Punjab Arms Amendment Ordinance, 2015. Police presented the suspect before Area Magistrate Talat Waheed to request physical custody in order to conduct further interrogation and investigate the circumstances surrounding the fatal shooting.

Following the court hearing, the magistrate approved the two-day physical remand, ordering the police to produce the suspect again once the period expires. Investigators initially noted that a male domestic worker at the home reported the victim's husband claiming the firearm had discharged accidentally.

The tragic killing drew widespread public grief and high-level attention, with First Lady Aseefa Bhutto-Zardari expressing deep sadness. She called for a thorough, impartial, and transparent investigation to uncover the facts and ensure that anyone responsible is held fully accountable.

stories.title: Former Police SHO Javed Abro Executed in Karachi Residence
stories.summary:
Police in Karachi have obtained CCTV footage showing an assailant executing former Station House Officer Javed Abro in a targeted attack lasting only 10 seconds. The incident occurred inside Abro's home located in Gulshan-e-Hadeed Phase II, where unidentified armed men opened fire. The gunman discharged eight bullets from point-blank range, with seven striking Abro and causing him to die instantly at the scene. His wife sustained serious injuries during the shooting and was transported to a hospital for medical treatment.

Additional video clips show the suspect entering the residence holding a firearm and fleeing via the same route after the shooting. Other footage captures an occupant retreating indoors upon hearing gunshots, alongside a bystander attempting to pursue the suspect in a parked car within the residential compound. Law enforcement officials have commenced collecting evidence from the crime scene while an active investigation proceeds. A formal First Information Report will be registered following the funeral prayers.

Investigators noted that Abro had been receiving life threats for several months prior to the attack. Furthermore, his brother, Assistant Sub-Inspector Muhammad Khan Abro, was shot dead in 2025 after returning from court, with Inspector Javed Abro acting as the complainant in that murder case. The suspect in the earlier assassination of the ASI was subsequently killed in a police encounter. In response to the current killing, Sindh Home Minister Ziaul Lanjar took notice of the incident in Steel Town and requested an official report from SSP Malir while directing police to swiftly identify and capture the culprits.

This high-profile targeted assassination highlights ongoing security concerns surrounding law enforcement personnel and their families in the region. The tragedy echoes historical familial violence tied to official duties and legal proceedings, compounding grief for the remaining relatives. Authorities face immense pressure to dismantle the network responsible for these coordinated threats and attacks against police officials.

As the investigation unfolds, community leaders and officials are monitoring the police response to ensure justice is served swiftly. The public release of CCTV footage marks a critical step in appealing for tips to track down the fleeing assailant. Meanwhile, security measures for vulnerable retired and active officers are likely to face renewed scrutiny in the wake of this fatal breach.

stories.title: Indian Share Markets Reach Eight-Month High Amid Falling Crude Prices
stories.summary:
Indian benchmark share indices advanced higher to achieve their highest closing levels in over eight months on Monday. The Nifty 50 increased by 0.23 percent to reach 25,044.65, while the Sensex gained 0.13 percent to settle at 81,106.65. These figures mark the highest close recorded since February 27, 2026, as domestic markets displayed consolidation patterns following a robust rally driven by declining crude oil costs and foreign capital inflows.

Brent crude futures declined by one percent to trade around $97 per barrel. This downward movement followed statements from US President Donald Trump indicating that fresh military actions against Iran were highly unlikely while ongoing diplomatic talks progressed. Domestically, financial markets are scheduled to close on Tuesday for the Diwali holiday and will reopen for trading on Wednesday.

Prior to Monday's session, the benchmarks surged approximately 10.5 percent across seven consecutive sessions through Friday, marking their longest winning streak of the year. This momentum was supported by strong foreign investments, lower oil prices, and the unwinding of global artificial intelligence trades. Global brokerages have responded positively, with Citi raising its end-2027 Nifty target to 28,000 and HSBC upgrading India from neutral to overweight.

Foreign institutional investors have purchased Indian shares exceeding $4.1 billion during November, marking the largest monthly inflow since September 2024. Pabitro Mukherjee, deputy vice president of research at Bajaj Broking, noted that short-term consolidation is possible at higher levels while stock-specific actions and the ongoing earnings season remain primary market triggers. Across sectors, thirteen of the sixteen major groups closed positively, led by pharma gains from Divi's Laboratories and Gland Pharma.

The broader market participation saw small-caps and mid-caps advance by 0.1 percent and 0.6 percent respectively. Meanwhile, information technology stocks declined by 1.2 percent, whereas heavyweight financials rose by 0.8 percent on the day. Broader Asian markets also rebounded following a turbulent week characterized by significant tech-sector drops driven by fluctuating computer chip demand.

stories.title: Indian Rupee Snaps Six-Day Winning Streak Due to Dollar Bids
stories.summary:
The Indian rupee halted a six-session winning streak on Monday amid thin trading volumes, pressured by dollar purchases from state-run lenders that outweighed recent positive momentum. Foreign exchange markets in India will remain closed on Tuesday in observance of a local holiday. The currency initially touched a six-month high of 93.69 per dollar, extending a more than one percent rally from the previous week, before closing slightly lower at 93.9275 compared to its prior close of 93.9050.

Market participants suggested that the dollar acquisitions by state-run banks could be executed on behalf of the central bank. These regulatory interventions have historically assisted in managing ongoing supply-demand imbalances within the domestic foreign exchange market. Simultaneously, a reduction in global crude oil prices helped relieve external pressures on the Indian currency, encouraging foreign investors to re-engage with local equities.

Madhavi Arora from Emkay Global noted that the Reserve Bank of India is likely to utilize sustained capital inflows to rebuild foreign exchange buffers instead of permitting excessive appreciation of the rupee. Factors such as the central bank's sizeable net short forward position and continuous current account funding requirements are expected to limit significant upside movement for the currency. The Reserve Bank's net short dollar position in the forward market reached an all-time high of nearly $240 billion in September, representing substantial future delivery obligations.

Externally, the US dollar strengthened following the release of a stronger-than-expected October jobs report. US non-farm payrolls grew by 165,000 positions during October, exceeding market expectations of 65,000 and driving the US 10-year Treasury yield upward. Additionally, a Reuters poll indicated that US retail inflation likely registered at 3.9 percent year-on-year for October, with official data scheduled for release on Tuesday evening.

A higher-than-anticipated inflation reading could solidify market expectations for another Federal Reserve interest rate hike, thereby offering renewed support to the US dollar, according to Amit Pabari, managing director at FX advisory firm CR Forex. These macroeconomic developments underscore the delicate balance foreign exchange traders must maintain between domestic policy interventions and shifting international monetary indicators.

stories.title: Drap Introduces Mehfooz Dawa App to Verify Medicine Authenticity
stories.summary:
The Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan has formally urged consumers to utilize its Mehfooz Dawa application to verify the authenticity and prices of pharmaceutical products. This initiative forms a central component of ongoing efforts by regulatory bodies to combat the widespread circulation and sale of counterfeit drugs across the nation. Sajid Shah, spokesperson for the Ministry of National Health Services, stated that approximately 800 pharmaceutical companies and upwards of 90,000 individual medicines are currently registered with Drap.

To facilitate verification, Drap implemented a 2D barcode system that allows consumers to scan medicine packaging directly, ensuring they acquire safe, effective, and high-quality medical products. The centralized track-and-trace system governing pharmaceutical distribution nationwide officially became operational on October 9. Authorities note that this digital tracking framework will significantly improve supply chain transparency and streamline product recalls in the event of consumer complaints or quality defects.

Smartphone users can easily scan the integrated barcodes to review detailed product specifications and official pricing structures. Although the concept for a national barcode system was initially proposed in 2015 and subsequently approved by the federal cabinet in 2017, implementation experienced prolonged bureaucratic delays. Federal Health Minister Mustafa Kamal eventually intervened, addressing the setbacks and mandating the earliest possible launch of the tracking framework.

Earlier this year, Drap established October 1 as the definitive cut-off date for deploying the barcode mechanism to eradicate black marketing, expired products, and counterfeit medications. Shah reaffirmed that the Ministry of National Health Services remains entirely dedicated to ensuring all citizens retain reliable access to safe and effective therapeutic goods. This technological upgrade represents a crucial milestone in safeguarding public health and restoring consumer confidence in the domestic pharmaceutical market.

stories.title: Pakistan Prime Minister Directs Urgent Humanitarian Aid for Flooded Gaza Tents
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif announced on Monday that he instructed the foreign ministry to utilize all possible channels to urgently scale up humanitarian assistance for Gaza. This directive follows heavy rains that lashed Gaza City’s Al-Remal neighbourhood, flooding tens of thousands of tents and severely impacting displaced Palestinians.

According to the Gaza government media office, at least 70,000 tents were flooded within a 12-hour period, resulting in injuries and the destruction of shelters, alongside 1,500 distress calls received by Gaza’s civil defence service. Municipal and civil defence officials noted that fuel shortages and the destruction of hundreds of vehicles, including bulldozers and water pumps by Israeli forces, left them unable to adequately respond to the severe storm.

Prime Minister Sharif described photographs of the flooded encampments as heart-rending, highlighting that Gazan children are trapped, starving, and facing extreme cold. He strongly condemned ongoing Israeli violations of the ceasefire and international law, as well as the continued denial of basic humanitarian assistance to the Palestinian population.

The region has faced extensive Israeli military operations since the October 7, 2023, attack by Hamas, with Palestinian authorities reporting over 74,000 deaths. Despite a US-brokered ceasefire agreement last year calling for territory reconstruction, Israeli forces continue to occupy more than 60 percent of the area, conduct daily airstrikes, and enforce strict limitations on aid, leaving the majority of Gaza's two million displaced residents reliant on sparse supplies.

Displaced residents recounted the severe difficulties caused by the torrential downpour. Local resident Olfat Magdoub shared that her bedding and mattresses were completely soaked, forcing her family to sleep directly on the ground. Another resident, Rafiq Ghattas, stated that the community possesses no resources, tarpaulins, or replacement tents to cope with the worsening weather conditions.

stories.title: Iran Defends Two-Day Peace Talk Proposal Following Critical US Response
stories.summary:
Iran defended its updated proposal on Monday to restart peace talks within just two days, maintaining that it is the most reasonable offer currently available. The statement from Tehran followed sharp criticism from US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who dismissed certain Iranian conditions as outrageous and ridiculous.

Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei addressed reporters during a weekly press conference to question the fairness of US objections. He asked whether it was unreasonable for Iran to insist that illegal American sanctions and the ongoing naval blockade be lifted, and hostilities ended on all fronts, prior to the commencement of negotiations. The new two-day timeline marks a shortening from an earlier seven-day proposal put forward by Tehran.

In addition to addressing the peace talks, Baghaei commented on regional diplomatic pressures, stating that recent US efforts urging Iraq to shut down most of its borders with Iran should not damage bilateral ties between Tehran and Baghdad. He also dismissed a newly established US military task force aimed at restricting Iran's land trade, characterizing the initiative as a political diversion following Republican losses in midterm elections under President Donald Trump.

The diplomatic exchange highlights ongoing tensions between Washington and Tehran regarding the prerequisites for dialogue. While Iran maintains that Washington must first halt hostilities and waive sanctions, US officials continue to push back against these demands, leaving the immediate future of potential peace negotiations uncertain.

stories.title: Brother of Late TV Anchor Rabia Ahsan Withdraws Murder FIR
stories.summary:
The brother of deceased television anchor Rabia Ahsan withdrew a First Information Report on Monday that he had filed just a day earlier, stating that her death was the result of an accidental shooting. Speaking to ARY News, the brother asserted that his brother-in-law had no intention of committing murder and that there was no previous dispute or altercation between the couple.

The incident took place at a house in Rawalpindi. According to the brother, his mother, another sister, two nieces, and a domestic worker were present at the scene when the tragedy occurred. Police initially registered a murder case under Section 302 of the Pakistan Penal Code at the Saddar Bairooni Police Station following a complaint from the deceased's brother, Khurram, who rushed to the home after receiving a phone call and found his sister lying dead in a pool of blood.

Preliminary investigations revealed that Rabia Ahsan and her husband, Ahsan, had been married for 14 years, and family members previously described their marriage as happy with no history of domestic discord. A preliminary statement from a domestic worker indicated that the family was organizing seasonal clothing by putting away summer attire and retrieving winter items from a cupboard. During this task, an unlicensed .30-bore pistol was discovered among the clothes.

The domestic worker told investigators that Ahsan picked up the weapon and waved it around before a shot accidentally discharged. The initial post-mortem report confirmed that the bullet struck the front lower part of Rabia Ahsan's neck, causing her death. Following the brother's new statement, local police have shifted the focus of their inquiry toward an accidental shooting angle and are awaiting forensic laboratory reports to proceed further.

stories.title: راولپنڈی: مقتولہ ٹی وی اینکر ربیعہ احسن کی نماز جنازہ، شوہر کا جسمانی ریمانڈ منظور
stories.summary:
راولپنڈی میں گزشتہ روز قتل ہونے والی ٹی وی اینکر ربیعہ احسن کی نمازِ جنازہ ادا کردی گئی ہے، جس میں اہلِ خانہ اور شہریوں کی بڑی تعداد نے شرکت کی۔ مقتولہ کو راولپنڈی کے علاقے اڈیالہ روڈ پر واقع گلشن آباد میں ان کے گھر کے اندر قتل کیا گیا تھا۔ اس اندمناک واقعے کے بعد پولیس نے مقتولہ کے بھائی کی مدعیت میں ان کے شوہر احسن کے خلاف مقدمہ درج کر کے اسے فوری طور پر حراست میں لے لیا تھا۔

قتل کے اس مقدمے میں پولیس نے ملزم شوہر احسن کو ڈسٹرکٹ کورٹ راولپنڈی میں پیش کیا، جہاں عدالت نے ملزم کا ایک روزہ جسمانی ریمانڈ منظور کر لیا۔ تفتیشی حکام کے مطابق ابتدائی پوچھ گچھ کے دوران ملزم شوہر احسن نے دعویٰ کیا تھا کہ اس سے اتفاقیہ گولی چل گئی تھی جو بدقسمتی سے ربیعہ کو جا لگی۔ پولیس کا کہنا ہے کہ واقعے کے تمام پہلوؤں کو مدنظر رکھتے ہوئے تحقیقات کا سلسلہ جاری ہے تاکہ اصل حقائق سامنے آ سکیں۔

stories.title: وزیراعظم شہباز شریف کا فلسطینیوں کو امداد سے محروم رکھنے پر تشویش کا اظہار
stories.summary:
وزیراعظم شہباز شریف نے فلسطینی عوام کو بنیادی انسانی امداد سے محروم رکھنے کے اسرائیلی غیرقانونی اقدامات پر گہرے تشویش کا اظہار کیا ہے۔ انہوں نے جنگ بندی کی خلاف ورزیوں اور فلسطینی عوام کے خلاف جاری جارحیت کی شدید مذمت بھی کی ہے۔

فلسطینی وزارت خارجہ کے مطابق، اس وقت چار لاکھ سے زائد بے گھر فلسطینی سیلاب زدہ علاقوں میں شدید موسم کی لپیٹ میں ہیں اور بغیر کسی بنیادی سامان یا سرے کے انتہائی بے سروسامانی کی زندگی گزار رہے ہیں۔

وزیراعظم شہباز شریف کا کہنا ہے کہ غزہ میں ان معصوم بچوں کی تصاویر انتہائی دل دہلا دینے والی ہیں جو پناہ گاہوں سے محروم ہیں، بے یار و مددگار پھنسے ہوئے ہیں اور شدید سردی اور بھوک کا شکار ہیں۔

اس صورتحال کے پیش نظر وزیراعظم نے وزارتِ خارجہ کو یہ سخت ہدایت جاری کی ہے کہ فلسطینی عوام تک انسانی امداد کی فراہمی کو بڑھانے کے لیے تمام ممکنہ ذرائع اور راستے فوری طور پر بروئے کار لائے جائیں۔

stories.title: Pakistani Security Forces Clear Mosque-Based Hideouts in North Waziristan
stories.summary:
Pakistani security forces executed an intelligence-based operation on Monday in Muzak village, located on the southern outskirts of Mir Ali in North Waziristan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. According to the military's media wing, the Inter-Services Public Relations, troops neutralized two terrorist hideouts and sanitized the area. The operation targeted elements belonging to Fitna al-Khawarij, a term the state applies to the banned Tehreek-i-Taliban Pakistan.

Military reports revealed that the terrorists had deliberately established hideouts inside local mosques to store a large cache of prepared improvised explosive devices, explosive materials, weapons, and ammunition. Authorities stated that the insurgents were also operating torture cells within these places of worship. The ISPR condemned the use of mosques, characterizing it as a desecration of religious sites by an Indian proxy group with support from the Afghan Taliban.

President Asif Ali Zardari praised the security forces for their professionalism and criticized the misuse of religious sites for violence and storage of explosives. Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Governor Faisal Karim Kundi also lauded the operation while describing the situation as deeply distressing and calling for intensified counter-terrorism efforts. The operation forms part of the ongoing counter-terrorism campaign under the vision Azm-i-Istehkam aimed at eliminating foreign-sponsored terrorism across Pakistan.

The security environment in regions like Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan has experienced continued volatility. Data from the Pakistan Institute for Conflict and Security Studies noted recent spikes in militant activity and counter-terrorism operations nationwide. Security forces have pledged to maintain their relentless campaign to wipe out the menace of terrorism from the country.

stories.title: فیصل آباد: چچا اور چچی نے 10 سالہ یتیم بچی پر پیٹرول چھڑک کر آگ لگا دی
stories.summary:
فیصل آباد کے علاقے تاندلیانوالہ میں ایک لرزہ خیز واقعہ پیش آیا جہاں مبینہ طور پر چچا اور چچی نے دس سالہ یتیم بچی پر پیٹرول چھڑک کر اسے آگ لگا دی۔ پولیس نے فوری کارروائی کرتے ہوئے ملزم چچا کو گرفتار کر لیا ہے۔

پولیس کے مطابق متاثرہ بچی کے والدین پہلے ہی انتقال کر چکے تھے اور وہ اپنے چھوٹے بھائی کے ہمراہ اپنے چچا کے گھر میں رہائش پذیر تھی۔ ابتدائی تحقیقات میں یہ بات سامنے آئی ہے کہ ملزمان اس بچی سے جبراً بھیک منگواتے تھے۔

ملزمان نے پیسے چھپانے کے مبینہ شبے میں پہلے معصوم بچی پر شدید تشدد کیا اور پھر اس پر پیٹرول چھڑک کر آگ کے حوالے کر دیا۔ واقعے کے بعد شدید زخمی حالت میں بچی کو فوری طور پر اسپتال منتقل کر دیا گیا۔

پولیس نے اس افسوسناک واقعے کا مقدمہ درج کر کے ملزم چچا کو حراست میں لے لیا ہے جبکہ اس انسانی سوز واقعے کی مزید تفتیش اور کارروائی اب بھی جاری رکھی جا رہی ہے۔

stories.title: ڈیرہ غازی خان: قصبہ کالا کی نہر سے نامعلوم خاتون کی لاش برآمد
stories.summary:
ڈیرہ غازی خان کے علاقے قصبہ کالا میں ایک نامعلوم خاتون کی نہر سے تیرتی ہوئی لاش برآمد ہوئی ہے جسے فوری طور پر اسپتال منتقل کر دیا گیا ہے۔

ریسکیو 1122 کے حکام کے مطابق انہیں قصبہ کالا کی ایک نہر میں لاش موجود ہونے کی اطلاع ملی تھی، جس کے بعد ریسکیو ٹیموں نے موقع پر پہنچ کر لاش کو باہر نکالا۔

پولیس کا کہنا ہے کہ برآمد ہونے والی لاش کو فی الحال شناخت کے لیے اسپتال میں رکھا گیا ہے تاکہ مقتولہ کی اصل شناخت کا پتہ لگایا جا سکے۔

ابتدائی اطلاعات کے بعد پولیس یہ جاننے کی کوشش کر رہی ہے کہ آیا خاتون کو باقاعدہ قتل کر کے نہر میں پھینکا گیا ہے یا اس کے پیچھے کوئی اور وجہ کارفرما ہے، جس کے لیے مکمل تحقیقات کا آغاز کر دیا گیا ہے۔

stories.title: Security Forces Neutralize Terrorist Hideouts in North Waziristan Village
stories.summary:
Pakistani security forces carried out an intelligence-based operation in Muzak village on the southern fringes of Mir Ali, North Waziristan, targeting reported terrorist hideouts linked to the group Fitna Al Khwarij. The military's media wing reported that troops successfully sanitized two hideouts established inside local mosques by the militants.

During the operation, authorities recovered a large cache of prepared Improvised Explosive Devices, explosive preparation materials, weapons, and ammunition. According to the military, the terrorists deliberately utilized places of worship to store explosives and operate torture cells. Officials criticized this actions as a reprehensible desecration that demonstrates a complete disregard for the fundamental teachings of Islam.

The military stated that these Kharji terrorists are abetted by the Afghan Taliban and hold no true connection to Islam, adding that their interpretation of religion is entirely rejected by the people of Pakistan. Sanitization operations by brave soldiers are ongoing to locate and eliminate any remaining militant hideouts in the area. Authorities emphasized that the relentless counter-terrorism campaign under the Azm-e-Istehkam vision, approved by the Federal Apex Committee on National Action Plan, will continue at full pace to eradicate foreign-sponsored terrorism from the country.

stories.title: High-Rise Building Fire in Northern Chinese City of Taiyuan Kills 14
stories.summary:
A fire broke out on Sunday evening at a high-rise building in Taiyuan, the capital of China's northern Shanxi province, resulting in at least 14 deaths. State media reported the casualties and noted that 25 individuals remained hospitalized, with nine suffering from serious injuries, following the blaze on a busy downtown main road.

Online video footage verified by Reuters showed thick smoke billowing over the 40-story structure as firefighters positioned on cranes fought the flames. State broadcasters stated that the fire originated around the fourth floor of a lower annex before spreading upward to the eighth and ninth floors, which accommodate a hotel. The structure itself is a mixed-use commercial and residential property housing hotels, short-term rental apartments, small venues, and tutoring centers.

Firefighters extinguished the blaze after roughly two hours, with rescue operations concluding by approximately 8:30 p.m. on Sunday night after 38 people had been transported to hospitals. Local authorities have initiated an investigation to determine the exact cause of the fatal incident in the northern manufacturing hub.

stories.title: Trump Calls Resumption of Iran War 'Highly Unlikely' Pending Strong Agreement
stories.summary:
US President Donald Trump stated that a resumption of fighting with Iran is "highly unlikely," though he conditioned any final decision on whether Tehran signs a "very strong agreement." Speaking to CNN ahead of a White House meeting with Qatari Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani, Trump noted that while he would take military action if necessary, past strikes had already heavily impacted the nation. The remarks follow recent US media speculation that hostilities might restart after midterm elections.

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi remarked that peace talks have been temporarily paused due to the political shock of the US midterm elections, which resulted in the Republican Party losing control of Congress. Araghchi blamed the unpopular war for the Republican defeat, asserting that the American public is weary of endless conflicts tied to Israel. He also commented on regional tensions and the ongoing diplomatic efforts involving mediators such as Qatar and Pakistan.

Trump maintained that severe economic pressure, pointing to high inflation figures, will ultimately force Iranian leaders to accept terms dictated by the United States. While outright military combat has largely decreased, low-level friction persists, including an overnight attack reported on Qeshm island in the Strait of Hormuz. Meanwhile, Iran continues efforts to blockade the strategic strait, while the US Navy maintains a counterblockade against Iranian ports.

The discussions come at a critical juncture for international diplomacy in the Gulf region. Although regional powers have spent months trying to secure a definitive end to the conflict, a lasting resolution remains elusive. The upcoming talks between Trump and Qatar's prime minister are expected to address the future of these stalled diplomatic channels and the parameters for any potential bilateral agreement.

stories.title: Marine Le Pen and Jean-Luc Melenchon Lead French Presidential Polls
stories.summary:
French far-right leader Marine Le Pen and hard-left rival Jean-Luc Melenchon have consolidated their commanding leads in voting intentions ahead of the upcoming presidential election. A survey conducted between November 3 and November 5 by pollster Toluna Harris Interactive highlights intensifying political polarization in the country as President Emmanuel Macron's final term draws to a close.

According to the poll, Marine Le Pen is projected to lead the first-round vote, securing between 34 percent and 36 percent depending on the testing scenarios. This maintains her strong standing from the previous month, where polling showed her support ranging between 35 percent and 37 percent. Meanwhile, Jean-Luc Melenchon, representing the far-left France Unbowed party, is expected to advance to a run-off across all five polled scenarios with either 18 percent or 19 percent of the vote.

The shifting political landscape is largely attributed to the conclusion of President Macron's second and final five-year term. Macron leaves behind a hollowed-out political center and a weak economy, which has successfully created an opening for hardline political factions on both ends of the spectrum. Polling scenarios indicate that Le Pen would comfortably defeat Melenchon in a head-to-head run-off vote.

Both candidates are veteran contenders in French presidential politics. Melenchon previously ran in the 2012, 2017, and 2022 elections but historically failed to break through to the second round. Similarly, Le Pen ran in those exact three election cycles, ultimately advancing to the second round in both 2017 and 2022, where she was defeated by Macron.

stories.title: Pakistani Leaders Pay Tribute to Allama Iqbal on 149th Birth Anniversary
stories.summary:
President Asif Ali Zardari and Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif paid tribute to Allama Muhammad Iqbal, known as the poet of the East, on his 149th birth anniversary. Both leaders emphasized that Iqbal's message of unity, peaceful coexistence, and selfhood continues to serve as a guiding beacon for the nation. Born in Sialkot in 1877, Iqbal was a renowned philosopher, scholar, and the ideological founder of Pakistan, famously articulating the two-nation theory at the 1930 Allahabad session of the Muslim League.

A public holiday was observed nationwide, accompanied by a Change of Guards ceremony at Iqbal’s mausoleum in Lahore. In his statement, Prime Minister Shehbaz highlighted Iqbal's crucial role in awakening political consciousness and national identity among the Muslims of the subcontinent. The prime minister also announced a year-long commemoration leading up to Iqbal's 150th anniversary on November 9, 2027, featuring international conferences, literary festivals, and educational competitions aimed at embedding his philosophy into the national education system and development priorities.

President Zardari echoed these sentiments in his address, urging the country's youth to draw inspiration from Iqbal's poetry to foster a spirit of critical inquiry and intellectual growth. He noted that Iqbal's vision called for a society built on freedom, equality, and dignity, where economic privilege does not dictate a citizen's worth. Zardari stressed that national self-respect requires the capacity to make independent decisions and engage with other countries on the basis of equality and mutual respect.

Both leaders emphasized the enduring relevance of Iqbal's core concepts, including Khudi (selfhood) and the Shaheen (falcon), which symbolize courage, independence, and an unwavering pursuit of excellence. As the region looks toward the dawn of an Asian century, the leadership stressed that Pakistan must realize this promise through education, scientific progress, regional cooperation, and a firm rejection of hatred, extremism, and sectarianism.

stories.title: Tesla to Issue Cybertruck Refunds as Demand and Production Plans Shift
stories.summary:
Tesla CEO Elon Musk announced that the company will be forced to issue refunds for numerous Cybertruck deposits because customer orders vastly exceed the manufacturer's production capacity. The update follows a recent announcement regarding the gradual wind-down of Cybertruck manufacturing at the company's Texas facility, slated for mid-2027. Musk explained that while Tesla will attempt to produce as many vehicles as possible before terminating the production line in approximately eight months, returning a large volume of deposits is unavoidable.

The production wind-down is part of a strategic shift to reallocate resources toward the Cybercab robotaxi, a vehicle considered central to Tesla's future autonomous-driving ambitions. Prior to halting the line, Tesla plans to add an extra production shift to fulfill outstanding Cybertruck orders. Despite high initial interest when deliveries began in late 2023, overall demand has fallen short of Musk's ambitious projections.

Market data from Kelley Blue Book indicates that US sales dropped by 48 percent to 20,237 units last year. This performance stands in sharp contrast to Musk's earlier forecasts, which optimistically predicted that annual sales for the electric pickup truck could eventually reach 250,000 vehicles. The scaling back of the Cybertruck project marks a significant pivot in Tesla's vehicle lineup and manufacturing priorities as the company focuses more heavily on autonomous ride-hailing technology.

stories.title: German Exports Rebound by Two Percent in September
stories.summary:
German exports unexpectedly increased by 2% in September compared to the previous month, driven primarily by strong demand from European Union member states. Data published on Monday by the federal statistics office revealed the growth, which outperformed the 0.5% increase predicted by analysts polled by Reuters following back-to-back monthly drops in July and August.

Alexander Krueger, chief economist at Bethmann Bank, noted that the data signals overall economic resilience against Chinese competition and indicates that foreign trade will support economic growth in the near term rather than act as its primary driver. Meanwhile, import figures also experienced a significant monthly boost, surging by 4.2% and easily outpacing the projected 0.5% expectation.

The unexpected upward movement in both import and export metrics provides a positive indicator for the broader German economy following a period of consecutive declines. Observers continue to monitor foreign trade dynamics as they help stabilize economic output amid ongoing international market challenges and competitive pressures.

stories.title: Gold Prices in Pakistan Surge Following Global Market Gains
stories.summary:
Gold prices in Pakistan experienced a significant upward shift on Monday, mirroring positive momentum observed in international markets. According to rates provided by the All-Pakistan Gems and Jewellers Sarafa Association (APGJSA), the domestic price of gold per tola climbed by Rs3,200 to reach a total of Rs432,336 during the trading day.

Alongside the per tola increase, the price for 10 grams of gold rose by Rs2,744, bringing it to a value of Rs370,658. This upward trend followed a period of stability in the local market, where the per tola rate had remained flat at Rs429,136 through Saturday without any daily price fluctuations.

The domestic increases directly reflected international trends, as global gold prices advanced by $32 to hit $4,098 per ounce. In addition to precious yellow metal gains, the local price of silver also registered an upward adjustment, climbing by Rs55 to settle at Rs5,723 per tola.

stories.title: SoftBank Faces Investor Scrutiny Over AI Strategy Amid Debt Concerns
stories.summary:
SoftBank Group is preparing to report its quarterly earnings on Tuesday, where executives will face intense questioning from investors regarding its artificial intelligence strategy and rising debt levels. The Japanese investment conglomerate has poured $64.6 billion into a 13% stake in OpenAI, making it highly vulnerable to a broader rout in tech stocks, recent regulatory skepticism following US midterm elections, and China's decision to block its $5.4 billion acquisition of ABB’s robotics division.

The company's financial exposure has heightened market anxiety, with net interest-bearing debt reaching 10.8 trillion yen ($68 billion) at the end of June, up sharply from 6.6 trillion yen a year earlier. These mounting pressures triggered an 11% drop in SoftBank's share price on Friday, followed by an additional 4.2% decline on Monday, pushing its losses to 23% for the year. Additionally, the cost of insuring its debt against default recently climbed to a four-year high.

Analysts polled by LSEG offer widely divergent forecasts for July-September net profits, ranging from a 233 billion yen gain to a 113 billion yen loss. Investors are also seeking clarity on future debt-based financing, as the falling value of key collateral holdings like chip designer Arm—whose shares have dropped roughly 60% from their June record high—places further strain on company finances.

Executives, including CFO Yoshimitsu Goto, are scheduled to address these concerns during the earnings briefing at 0730 GMT. Industry experts suggest that SoftBank may be forced to adopt a defensive posture by slowing down investments, cutting debt, or selling off portfolio positions to navigate the current market headwinds.

stories.title: Debutants Shine as Pakistan Reaches 137-2 at Lunch Against Sri Lanka
stories.summary:
Pakistan reached 137-2 by lunch on the opening day of the first Test against Sri Lanka at the Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium on Monday. Sri Lanka won the toss and elected to field on a green-top pitch, bringing four pacers and omitting a frontline spinner. The two-match series forms part of the ICC World Test Championship 2025-27 cycle, which currently sees Pakistan at the bottom of the table and Sri Lanka in seventh place.

Twenty-year-old debutant Mohammad Tayyab Arif made a brisk 57 runs off 51 balls, hitting nine boundaries and a six. He shared an 86-run opening partnership with Azan Awais, who contributed 30 runs before being caught behind by wicketkeeper Kusal Mendis off bowler Milan Rathnayaka in the 16th innings over. Arif later edged an Asitha Fernando delivery to Mendis to leave Pakistan at 90-2.

Following the breakthroughs, captain Babar Azam and fellow debutant Mohammad Taha stabilized the innings through cautious play. At the break, Babar was unbeaten on 31 after surviving early pressure with four boundaries, while Taha was not out on 15. The Pakistan playing XI also features debuts for all-rounder Arafat Minhas and fast bowler Saqib Khan, following squad adjustments announced by the Pakistan Cricket Board over the weekend.

stories.title: Pakistan reaches 110/2 against Sri Lanka as debutant Arif scores 57
stories.summary:
Sri Lanka won the toss and chose to field first against Pakistan in the opening Test of the series at the Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium. Pakistan's debutant Tayyab Arif made a strong start to his Test career, contributing 57 runs from 51 deliveries before being caught by Kusal Mendis off Asitha Fernando's bowling. His knock featured nine boundaries and one six.

Following his dismissal, Pakistan advanced to 110/2 in 22 overs after being invited to bat first. Four Pakistani players are making their Test debuts in this fixture as the home side aims for a positive start to the series. The opening Test of the Sri Lanka tour of Pakistan is scheduled from November 9 to 13, 2026.

Separately, in Rawalpindi, the brother of the late television anchor Rabia Ahsan withdrew the FIR he filed a day earlier, classifying the event as an accident. Speaking to ARY News, the victim's brother stated that the incident involved accidental firing and that his brother-in-law did not shoot with harmful intent.

stories.title: Change of Guards Ceremony Held at Allama Iqbal Mausoleum in Lahore
stories.summary:
A simple and graceful Change of Guards ceremony took place at the mausoleum of Dr. Allama Muhammad Iqbal in Lahore this morning. The event was held to honor the national poet and philosopher of Pakistan.

A smart and agile contingent of the Pakistan Navy assumed honorary guard duties at the site, taking over from the Pakistan Rangers Punjab for the day. Pakistan Navy Station Commander Lahore, Commodore Misbah-ul-Amin, served as the chief guest and received a guard of honor during the proceedings.

In a separate unrelated development in Rawalpindi, the brother of deceased television anchor Rabia Ahsan withdrew an FIR he registered a day prior. He told ARY News that the shooting was accidental and that his brother-in-law had no intention to open fire.

stories.title: UN Chief Antonio Guterres Urges World Leaders to Get Serious as COP31 Opens
stories.summary:
United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres called on global leaders to get serious about addressing climate change as the COP31 conference commenced in Antalya, Turkey. Negotiators immediately faced friction over financial issues. Thousands of delegates gathered at the Mediterranean expo centre following a year marked by extreme weather, including severe European heatwaves, Indonesian wildfires, and catastrophic floods in Nepal, exacerbated by a strong El Nino phenomenon.

The opening ceremony faced a one-hour delay without explanation after negotiators spent late Sunday arguing over developing nations' demands to include climate finance on the official agenda. Poorer countries argue that financial support from historically high-emitting developed nations remains insufficient. Meanwhile, the World Meteorological Organisation released a report indicating that 2026 continues a trend of exceptional global temperatures, melting ice, and rising sea levels.

Turkey is presiding over COP31 alongside Australia, which is leading the negotiations. The hosts are promoting an action agenda centered on an electrification drive to increase global energy demand met by electricity from 20 percent to 35 percent by 2035. However, this proposal may spark debates regarding clean electrification and the future role of fossil fuels.

The climate summit takes place without official representatives from climate-sceptic US President Donald Trump, though a congressional delegation is in attendance. Observers expect few major breakthroughs as countries navigate geopolitical tensions, an oil price shock, and the long-term challenge of keeping global warming below the Paris Agreement thresholds.

stories.title: Debutant Arif Scores Fifty as Pakistan Reaches 137-2 Against Sri Lanka
stories.summary:
Pakistan reached 137-2 at lunch on the opening day of the first Test match against Sri Lanka at the Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium on Monday. Sri Lanka won the toss and elected to field on a green-top pitch. The two matches form part of the ICC World Test Championship 2025-27 cycle, in which Pakistan currently sits at the bottom of the standings while Sri Lanka is in seventh place.

Twenty-year-old debutant Mohammad Tayyab Arif made a brisk 57 runs off 51 balls, hitting nine boundaries and a single six. He shared an 86-run opening partnership with Azan Awais, who contributed 30 runs before being caught behind by wicketkeeper Kusal Mendis off bowler Milan Rathnayaka in the 16th innings over. Arif was later dismissed when Asitha Fernando induced an edge taken again by Mendis, bringing the score to 90-2.

At the lunch break, captain Babar Azam was unbeaten on 31 runs after surviving early pressure to hit four boundaries. Another debutant, Mohammad Taha, was not out on 15 runs alongside his captain. Alongside Arif and Taha, players Arafat Minhas and Saqib Khan are also making their Test debuts for Pakistan in this series.

The Pakistan Cricket Board recently expanded the squad to 16 players by adding pace-allrounder Aamir Jamal and three uncapped talents following strong domestic performances. Meanwhile, Sri Lanka entered the match under captain Kusal Mendis with four fast bowlers and no frontline spinner, featuring experienced names like Dinesh Chandimal and Dhananjaya de Silva.

stories.title: Security Forces Clear Terrorist Hideouts Inside Mosques During North Waziristan Raid
stories.summary:
Pakistani security forces successfully cleared two alleged terrorist hideouts located inside mosques during an intelligence-based operation in North Waziristan. The Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) reported that the raid took place on November 8 in Muzak village, situated on the southern outskirts of Mir Ali. The targeted sites belonged to the Indian-backed group Fitna al-Khawarij.

During the operation, troops recovered a large cache of weapons, ammunition, prepared improvised explosive devices (IEDs), and bomb-making materials. According to military statements, the terrorists had deliberately utilized the places of worship to store explosives and run torture cells, actions described as a severe desecration of religious sites by individuals unconnected to Islam.

Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif commended the security forces for their professionalism during the successful intelligence-based operation. He echoed statements regarding the desecration of sacred places and emphasized that the group's actions reflect a complete deviation from Islamic teachings. He reaffirmed that counterterrorism operations by law enforcement will continue with full force.

A sanitisation operation is currently underway in the area to track down any remaining threats. The military's actions form part of the broader Azm-e-Istehkam counterterrorism campaign, which was approved by the Federal Apex Committee under the National Action Plan to eliminate foreign-sponsored terrorism across the country.

stories.title: Trump Says Suggestion to Appoint UFC CEO as Press Secretary Was a Joke
stories.summary:
US President Donald Trump stated on Sunday that he was merely joking when he suggested Ultimate Fighting Championship (CEO) Dana White as his next White House press secretary. The remarks followed a social media post from the previous day that had sparked speculation regarding White's potential recruitment and highlighted a combative strategy toward Democrats as they prepare to take control of Congress.

Trump told reporters that while White would likely welcome the position, the proposal was intended as lighthearted fun. In his Saturday social media post, Trump had praised White as a violent fighter and warrior, while jokingly suggesting that several current and former UFC champions be brought on as assistants to defend his administration against political opponents. Trump also noted that White was scheduled to visit him at the White House on Monday for unrelated matters.

Dana White, who has led the UFC for over twenty years, is a prominent ally who actively campaigned for Trump during the 2024 presidential race. White has frequently appeared alongside Trump at political functions and helped facilitate UFC events on the White House lawn earlier in the year.

The lighthearted clarification comes amid other recent staffing adjustments within Trump's administration, including the departure of White House spokeswoman Katie Zacharia and the promotion of Stephen Miller to chief of staff, succeeding Susie Wiles.

stories.title: Ousted Bangladeshi Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina Seeks New Passport to Return
stories.summary: Former Bangladeshi Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has requested a new passport and national identity card in her first communication since fleeing into self-imposed exile in India in 2024. Lawyers from London-based Matrix Chambers submitted the formal request on Monday to Preeti Rahman, the acting high commissioner at Bangladesh’s embassy in New Delhi. The application asks for expedited processing based on her nationality and international human rights obligations, following the reported revocation of her previous documents by interim authorities. This move represents Hasina's clearest step toward acting on her plan to return to Bangladesh in December. Over two years ago, a deadly student-led uprising ended her long tenure, and a war-crimes court subsequently sentenced her to death in absentia last November for her role in the crackdown, allegations she has consistently denied. Her aides stated that a specific date for her return will be announced after formalities are completed, with Hasina planning to surrender before a court. Her party, the Awami League, is currently banned, and many colleagues remain jailed or exiled. Hasina governed Bangladesh for 20 years across multiple terms and still retains support among certain populations. Her potential return could amplify political tensions in Dhaka as the government struggles to maintain stability, while simultaneously potentially easing strained diplomatic relations between Bangladesh and India, which worsened after New Delhi granted her refuge.

stories.title: Karachi Triumphs in PIA Aircraft Cabin Cleanliness Competition
stories.summary: Karachi secured the top position in Pakistan International Airlines' aircraft cabin cleanliness competition, while Lahore finished as the runner-up. The contest evaluated airline stations in Karachi, Lahore, and Islamabad as part of a wider initiative to elevate passenger experience, service quality, and maintenance standards across the fleet. Evaluation teams inspected aircraft to measure cleanliness during a special simultaneous cleaning drive across the three stations. A recognition ceremony was subsequently hosted at the airline's Islamabad office to honor the employees whose performance stood out during the campaign. Outstanding staff members received shields, certificates, and cash awards for their contributions. Adrian Hamilton-Manns, the newly appointed Chief Executive Officer of Pakistan International Airlines, emphasized during the event that keeping aircraft in peak condition is a top priority for maintaining the airline's high brand standards. Hamilton-Manns, an aviation industry veteran with over thirty years of commercial experience including past leadership roles as CEO of three airlines in Africa, Kazakhstan, and Oman, recently assumed his office. Tasked with implementing operational reforms and restructuring, he is leading ongoing efforts to enhance overall service quality and strengthen the national carrier's standing within the global aviation industry.

stories.title: Prime Minister and President Honor Allama Iqbal on 149th Birth Anniversary
stories.summary: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and President Asif Ali Zardari paid tribute to Allama Muhammad Iqbal, known as the poet of the East, on his 149th birth anniversary. Born in Sialkot in 1877, Iqbal was a philosopher, scholar, and poet who first articulated the two-nation theory during the 1930 Allahabad session of the Muslim League, paving the way for Pakistan's creation on August 14, 1947. Commemorations included a public holiday declared by the federal government and a Change of Guards ceremony held at his mausoleum in Lahore. In his official message, Prime Minister Shehbaz praised Iqbal for awakening political consciousness among subcontinent Muslims and announced a year-long program of national and international events leading up to the 150th anniversary on November 9, 2027. The premier highlighted Iqbal's concept of Khudi, or selfhood, and the metaphor of the Shaheen falcon, emphasizing peace, social harmony, and tolerance while rejecting extremism and discrimination. President Zardari also honored the philosopher, urging the nation's youth to draw inspiration from his poetry to develop critical inquiry faculties and pursue freedom, equality, and self-respect. Both leaders stressed that Iqbal's vision of unity, universal brotherhood, and independent national decision-making remains vital for Pakistan's development and its role within the region as it approaches an Asian century.

stories.title: لاہور میں پولیس نے بروقت کارروائی کر کے 13 سالہ بچی کی شادی ناکام بنا دی
stories.summary:
لاہور کے علاقے لیاقت آباد میں پولیس نے بروقت کارروائی کرتے ہوئے کم عمر بچی کی شادی کی تقریب کو ناکام بنا دیا اور موقع سے کئی افراد کو گرفتار کر لیا۔

پولیس کے مطابق لیاقت آباد کے ایک مقامی شادی ہال میں تقریب جاری تھی جہاں تیرہ سالہ بچی کی رخصتی کی تیاری کی جا رہی تھی۔ پولیس ریکارڈ کے مطابق اس بچی کا نکاح رواں سال چار اکتوبر کو پڑھایا گیا تھا۔

اس غیر قانونی کارروائی پر فوری ایکشن لیتے ہوئے پولیس نے دولہا سبط الحسن اور بچی کے والد سبطین سمیت کل چھ ملزمان کو حراست میں لے لیا ہے۔

گرفتار کیے گئے تمام ملزمان کے خلاف تھانہ لیاقت آباد میں باقاعدہ مقدمہ درج کر لیا گیا ہے اور اس کم عمر شادی کے معاملے پر مزید تفتیش کا عمل جاری ہے۔

stories.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Faces Board Probe Over Foreign Intelligence Links
stories.summary: Nvidia Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang is facing an internal board investigation to determine if he was targeted in a foreign intelligence operation. The scrutiny follows a media report by The New York Times alleging that Huang had a relationship with Alice Huang, an unrelated former executive at Singapore-based cloud computing firm Megaspeed. US authorities previously investigated Alice Huang, concluding she acted as a Chinese intelligence asset and allegedly passed information to Beijing. Megaspeed operates as an Nvidia customer and an Asia-Pacific cloud partner, offering advanced Nvidia chips that are restricted from shipment to China under US export controls. Jensen Huang, 63, co-founded Nvidia in 1993 and transformed the company into a dominant supplier of artificial intelligence processors, driving its market valuation from $420 billion in late 2022 to $4.5 trillion by November 6. Following the media report, senior Republicans in the US House of Representatives requested briefings from Huang due to national security concerns. Nvidia stated that an independent committee of directors, supported by outside legal counsel, is reviewing all available data, and the company currently has no reason to believe that corporate secrets or national security were compromised. Huang has expressed full support for the review and committed to cooperating fully with the investigation, which comes during a sensitive period for the tech giant amid investor questions regarding the sustainability of the ongoing AI boom and geopolitical tech tensions between Washington and Beijing.

stories.title: Islamabad Police Recover Rs 1.62 Billion in Stolen Goods
stories.summary:
Islamabad Capital Territory Police detained 20,883 suspects and retrieved stolen property valued exceeding Rs 1.62 billion during the initial ten months of the year. The total number of lawbreakers apprehended included 1,197 operatives belonging to 509 distinct criminal rings. These syndicates specialized in offenses such as robberies, street crimes, burglaries, and vehicle thefts across the capital region.

An official from the police department reported on Monday that law enforcement executed precise operations targeting gangs, proclaimed offenders, drug traffickers, and people unlawfully possessing or displaying weapons. The dismantled criminal groups yielded significant recoveries consisting of 194 vehicles, 668 motorcycles, precious gold ornaments, and high-value mobile devices worth millions of rupees.

The initiative forms part of broader security efforts administered by local authorities to maintain public safety and curb organized crime within the federal capital. Targeted actions continue to focus on neutralizing threats from persistent criminal networks operating in the area.

These ongoing policing measures matter because recovering substantial stolen assets and dismantling hundreds of gangs directly enhances urban safety and reduces property crimes. The comprehensive operations demonstrate law enforcement capability in tackling complex criminal enterprises within the metropolitan jurisdiction.

stories.title: Trump Says Fresh Iran Strikes Unlikely as Talks Progress
stories.summary:
US President Donald Trump stated in a phone interview with CNN that he is highly unlikely to order fresh military strikes against Iran as long as diplomatic talks aimed at resolving the conflict continue to progress. Trump noted that avoiding further attacks depends on whether both nations sign a strong agreement, though he added that potential infrastructure targets, including 38 bridges, have already been identified if military action needs to resume.

Meanwhile, both the United States and Iran reported incidents involving shipping vessels in and near the Strait of Hormuz. Iran's state television indicated that evening explosions might be linked to military activity in the waterway, where two oil tankers reportedly caught fire after hitting unauthorized routes and mines. The US military stated that its air force had disabled a commercial vessel in the Gulf of Oman, while UK maritime monitors reported a separate incident involving a bulk carrier near Khor Fakkan.

Domestically, Trump acknowledged that the conflict with Iran contributed to Republican defeats in recent US midterm elections, while Vice President JD Vance explicitly stated that the war was the primary reason for the losses. Secretary of State Marco Rubio defended the administration's stance, describing the Iranian threat as real and noting that current diplomatic efforts have stalled because Iranian demands are unrealistic.

Qatar continues mediation efforts, denying claims that a deal has failed, while a senior Iranian official confirmed Tehran submitted a nuclear proposal dependent on prior sanctions relief, asset access, and war reparations. The ongoing disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz continue to impact global energy exports and international commodity markets, highlighting the critical economic stakes of the conflict.

stories.title: Karachi Industrial Hubs Suffer from Severe Infrastructure Decay
stories.summary:
Workers and business owners in Karachi's major industrial zones, including SITE and Korangi, face severe daily challenges due to crumbling roads, traffic gridlocks, and deficient public services. Commuters like Muhammad Ali and Ishtiaq Ali report losing hours navigating broken pavement and congested routes. Industrial transport fleets carrying raw materials and finished goods suffer similar delays, resulting in financial losses through inflated fuel bills and damaged cargo.

Beyond deteriorating roads, businesses grapple with poor sanitation, water shortages, inefficient waste disposal, and failing drainage networks. Industry leaders recently convened to voice concerns over civic mismanagement in Pakistan's commercial capital, which generates approximately 67 percent of federal revenue and 54 percent of national exports. Business representatives highlighted that despite a provincial allocation of over Rs 9 billion approved in December 2025 for urgent repairs, critical infrastructure work remains incomplete or delayed.

Industrialists attribute these persistent problems to institutional incompetence, weak accountability, and administrative failures. While Korangi Industrial Trading Estate CEO Saleemuz Zaman emphasized the urgent need for sewerage upgrades, Karachi Mayor Murtaza Wahab assured members that allocations would increase in upcoming financial years to support commercial activities and employment.

These infrastructure deficiencies matter because they directly undermine national economic productivity, inflate production costs, and prolong daily commutes for thousands of workers. Timely execution of repair projects and improved administrative coordination remain essential for restoring the viability of Karachi's vital commercial zones.

stories.title: امریکہ میں لابنگ فرم کے ذریعے رابطوں کی خبر پر بھارتی سیاست میں تنازع
stories.summary:
امریکہ کی ایک لابنگ فرم کی دستاویزات سامنے آنے کے بعد بھارتی حکومت کو اپوزیشن جماعتوں کی جانب سے سخت تنقید کا سامنا کرنا پڑ رہا ہے۔ میڈیا رپورٹس کے مطابق اس فرم نے دعویٰ کیا ہے کہ اس نے رواں سال مئی اور جون کے دوران بھارتی حکومت اور وائٹ ہاؤس کے اعلیٰ حکام کے درمیان آٹھ فون کالز کے انتظامات میں کردار ادا کیا تھا۔

رپورٹس میں بتایا گیا ہے کہ ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ کے دوبارہ صدر بننے کے بعد واشنگٹن میں بھارتی سفارت خانے نے مرکری پبلک افیئرز جیسی اہم لابنگ فرموں کی خدمات حاصل کی تھیں، جن میں سے ایک کو 75 ہزار ڈالر ماہانہ کے عوض مقرر کیا گیا تھا۔ اس انکشاف کے بعد کانگریس اور دیگر اپوزیشن رہنماؤں نے دعویٰ کیا ہے کہ وزیرِ اعظم نریندر مودی کو امریکی صدر سے بات کرنے اور تعریف کروانے کے لیے ٹیکس دہندگان کے پیسوں سے لابنگ فرم کی مدد لینا پڑتی ہے۔

دوسری جانب بھارتی وزارتِ خارجہ کے فیکٹ چیک یونٹ نے اس نوعیت کے دعوؤں کو مسترد کرتے ہوئے انہیں گمراہ کن قرار دیا ہے۔ وزارت کا موقف ہے کہ سفارت خانوں کی جانب سے لابنگ فرموں کی خدمات حاصل کرنا ایک روایتی اور پرانا عمل ہے جو 1948 سے جاری ہے، اور اس کا دوطرفہ تعلقات یا ان رابطوں سے کوئی تعلق نہیں ہے۔

اس معاملے پر مبصرین اور صحافیوں کی طرف سے بھی مختلف آراء سامنے آئی ہیں، جہاں کچھ ماہرین کا کہنا ہے کہ لابنگ فرمیں عام طور پر کانگریس کے امور میں مدد دیتی ہیں نہ کہ براہِ راست اعلیٰ سرکاری حکام کی بات چیت میں۔ یہ تنازع ایسے وقت میں سامنے آیا ہے جب دونوں ملکوں کے دوطرفہ تعلقات اور سفارتی سرگرمیاں زیرِ بحث ہیں۔

stories.title: Prime Minister Shehbaz Condemns Israeli Restrictions on Gaza Aid
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif expressed deep concern over Israel's ongoing denial of basic humanitarian assistance to the population of Gaza. In a statement posted on social media, he highlighted the severe plight of Palestinian children enduring extreme cold, starvation, and flooded living spaces. He strongly denounced violations of international law, the ceasefire, and continued aggression against the region.

In response to the escalating crisis, Prime Minister Shehbaz directed the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to pursue all available avenues to urgently increase humanitarian assistance for Gaza. This directive follows torrential rains that flooded tens of thousands of makeshift tents housing displaced individuals, washing away shelters and soaking essential bedding.

The Gaza government media office reported that at least 70,000 tents suffered flooding within a 12-hour period, injuring numerous residents. Additionally, the territory's civil defence service logged 1,500 distress calls from displaced civilians, alongside reports of three abandoned structures collapsing without causing casualties.

This situation matters as vulnerable populations in Gaza face compounded hardships from severe weather and restricted aid delivery. The official Pakistani response underscores international calls for immediate humanitarian relief and adherence to international protections for displaced civilians.

stories.title: AI Power Surge Drives High Demand for Used Gas Turbines
stories.summary:
Utilities, developers, and energy firms powering artificial intelligence data centres are increasingly turning to second-hand gas turbines, refurbished machines, and converted jet engines. This trend is driven by severe supply bottlenecks, as delivery windows for new equipment stretch into the 2030 to 2031 timeframe. Aurora Tenorio, a senior analyst at Wood Mackenzie, noted that US turbine delivery times now average six years. While global manufacturing capacity is expanding, it falls significantly short of the soaring demand.

To bypass lengthy backlogs, companies are actively scouring a secondary market described by industry leaders as very hot, leading to escalating prices. EthosEnergy CEO Ana Amicarella and Sulzer aftermarket leader Darayus Pardivala both highlighted the heavy influx of requests for used units. According to Zach Machuca of Origin Partners, well-maintained used units sell for approximately $1.5 million to $1.7 million per megawatt, while refurbished units cost around $1.3 million. These figures compare favourably to new turbines priced between $2 million and $2.5 million per megawatt, though some smaller units have traded at even steeper discounts.

Despite the cost and time savings, relying on second-hand equipment introduces distinct challenges. Analysts point out that overhauled turbines often feature unclear maintenance histories, limited remaining lifespan, and weak long-term servicing. Furthermore, converted jet engines raise questions regarding their suitability for continuous power generation. Additional hurdles, such as air permits and grid access, also contribute to project delays.

The unprecedented demand from data centres has impacted players across the broader energy sector, causing price surges for all types of equipment. Non-profit utilities and organizations like the National Rural Electric Cooperative Association report facing unprecedented lead times. Consequently, some developers are exploring alternatives, such as gas engines offered by Finland's Wartsila, which has secured substantial orders from US data centres to mitigate power supply constraints.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz Orders Urgent Humanitarian Assistance for Rain-Hit Gaza
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif announced on Monday that he has directed the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to pursue all possible means to urgently escalate humanitarian assistance to Gaza. The directive follows heavy rains that lashed the region, flooding tens of thousands of tents housing displaced Palestinians. According to the Gaza government media office, at least 70,000 tents were flooded within a 12-hour period, displacing thousands, causing injuries, and washing away vulnerable shelters.

Gaza's civil defence service reported receiving 1,500 distress calls from affected residents. Municipal and civil defence officials stated they were unable to manage the storm due to severe fuel shortages and extensive equipment damage, noting that Israel had destroyed hundreds of vehicles, including bulldozers and water-pumping trucks, during its military assault. Prime Minister Shehbaz described photos from Gaza as heart-rending, highlighting that children were trapped, starving, and subjected to extreme cold with nowhere to go.

The prime minister expressed deep concern over ongoing Israeli actions denying basic humanitarian aid to the Palestinian people. He strongly condemned these violations of the ceasefire and international law, alongside continued aggression in the territory. Since the escalation following the October 7, 2023, attack by Hamas, Palestinian authorities report that over 74,000 people have been killed in Gaza, where the majority of the population relies on aid supplies amid severe restrictions.

Residents across Gaza encampments struggled to cope with the deluge, using sand to reinforce shelters and sweeping away rainwater from flooded bedding and floors. Displaced individuals reported lacking basic resources, tarpaulins, and dry sleeping spaces. Despite a US-brokered ceasefire agreement last year that called for reconstruction, little progress has been made, with Israeli forces maintaining control over significant portions of the territory and conducting frequent airstrikes.

stories.title: Lahore Tops Global Pollution Rankings as Smog and AQI Exceed 600
stories.summary:
Lahore was ranked the world's most polluted major city on Monday, with its Air Quality Index reaching 590 according to IQAir, while historical platform readings recorded an hourly index of 647 in the hazardous category. The city's pollution level was more than three times higher than the second-ranked city. Within Lahore, severe air quality was recorded across multiple neighbourhoods, including Allama Iqbal Town with an AQI of 1,033, the CERP Office at 864, and Burki Road Paragon at 748. The crisis has also affected other parts of Punjab, with hazardous readings reported in Raiwind, Multan, and Faisalabad.

The severe deterioration in air quality arrived a day after the Punjab government warned that smoke from Diwali fireworks in neighbouring Indian Punjab, combined with crop-residue burning and easterly winds, would aggravate pollution. A provincial government report noted that 2,347 agricultural fire incidents had been recorded in Indian Punjab up to November 4, with nearly half located in border districts opposite Lahore and Kasur. However, satellite data from NASA's VIIRS analyzed by Hamari Hawa showed significantly higher fire detections on the Pakistani side of the border between October 1 and 29, indicating extensive domestic agricultural burning as well.

Air pollution remains a major global health risk, ranking as the second-leading risk factor for deaths worldwide and claiming approximately 8.1 million lives annually, with outdoor particulate matter accounting for 4.7 million of those deaths. In response to the crisis in Lahore, the Punjab Environment Protection Agency reported deploying specialized night squads, drones, and fire-fighting units to crack down on stubble burning. The Punjab Climate Watch Hub has been actively utilizing satellite anomaly detection to identify vulnerable locations for on-ground verification.

The provincial government expects pollution levels to remain elevated before seeing a slight improvement. The Environment Protection Department plans to release comparative findings to assess the distinct contributions of cross-border sources, local emissions, and weather conditions to the persistent smog enveloping the region.

stories.title: شمالی وزیرستان کے علاقے میر علی میں سیکیورٹی فورسز کا کامیاب انٹیلی جنس آپریشن
stories.summary:
پاکستان کی سیکیورٹی فورسز نے شمالی وزیرستان کے علاقے میر علی کے گاؤں موزاک میں ایک انٹیلی جنس بیسڈ آپریشن کیا ہے۔ پاک فوج کے شعبۂ تعلقاتِ عامہ (آئی ایس پی آر) کے مطابق اس کارروائی کے دوران فتنہ الخوارج کی جانب سے مساجد میں قائم کیے گئے دو اہم ٹھکانوں کو مکمل طور پر کلیئر کرایا گیا۔

آئی ایس پی آر نے بتایا کہ دہشت گردوں نے ان مساجد کو دھماکا خیز مواد ذخیرہ کرنے اور ٹارچر سیل چلانے کے لیے استعمال کیا۔ سیکیورٹی فورسز نے اس کارروائی میں بھاری مقدار میں اسلحہ، گولہ بارود اور آئی ای ڈیز برآمد کی ہیں، جن میں مجموعی طور پر 2.9 ٹن دھماکا خیز مواد بھی شامل ہے۔

فوج کے ترجمان کا کہنا ہے کہ مساجد جیسے مقدسات کا اس طرح کا استعمال اسلام کی بنیادی تعلیمات سے کھلی بے پرواہی اور غفلت کا ثبوت ہے۔ حکام کے مطابق افغان طالبان کی پشت پناہی سے چلنے والے ان خارجی عناصر کا اسلام سے کوئی تعلق نہیں ہے، اور ان کی جانب سے مذہب کا غلط استعمال کسی صورت قابلِ قبول نہیں ہے۔

علاقے میں امن و امان کی بحالی کے لیے سیکیورٹی فورسز کا کلیئرنس آپریشن تاحال جاری ہے۔ خیبر پختونخوا سمیت پورے ملک کے غیور عوام نے دہشت گردوں کی ان مذموم کارروائیوں اور مساجد کے تقدس پامال کرنے کے عمل کو سختی سے مسترد کر دیا ہے۔

stories.title: کراچی: نانا کے ساتھ موٹرسائیکل پر جاتے ہوئے پتنگ کی ڈور سے بچی جاں بحق
stories.summary:
کراچی کے علاقے لیاقت آباد میں ایک دلخراش واقعہ پیش آیا جہاں نانا کے ساتھ موٹرسائیکل پر سوار ہو کر جانے والی کمسن بچی گلے پر پتنگ کی ڈور پھرنے کے باعث موقع پر ہی جاں بحق ہو گئی۔ متوفی بچی کے نانا نذیر نے میڈیا کو بتایا کہ خطرناک پتنگ کی ڈور پہلے ان کے اپنے ہاتھ پر لگی اور پھر فوری بعد بچی کے گلے پر پھر گئی، جس سے شدید نقصان پہنچا۔

نانا نذیر کے مطابق وہ زخمی بچی کو فوری طور پر اسپتال لے کر جا رہے تھے لیکن وہ راستے میں ہی ایمبولینس کے اندر دم توڑ گئی۔ انہوں نے مزید بتایا کہ وہ اس واقعے پر کسی کے خلاف کوئی قانونی کارروائی کرنے کا ارادہ نہیں رکھتے، تاہم انہوں نے پتنگ اڑانے والوں سے انتہائی پرزور اپیل کی ہے کہ وہ اس جان لیوا کھیل کو کھیلنا چھوڑ دیں کیونکہ آج ان کی بچی گئی ہے اور کل کسی اور کے ساتھ بھی یہ المیہ پیش آ سکتا ہے۔

stories.title: Pakistan International Airlines Launches Fleet-Wide Deep-Cleaning Initiative
stories.summary:
Pakistan International Airlines has initiated a thorough cleaning campaign across its aircraft fleet in order to elevate cabin cleanliness and overall maintenance standards. The carrier carried out specialized cabin inspections and cleaning procedures at airports located in Karachi, Lahore, and Islamabad.
