Adrian Hamilton-Manns, the newly appointed Chief Executive Officer of the airline, stressed that maintaining aircraft cleanliness is exceptionally crucial for upholding the highest standards of the company's brand. He noted that keeping the fleet in top-tier condition represents a primary focus and serves as the foundation for an ongoing process to secure optimal aircraft quality.

To acknowledge outstanding contributions toward the project, the airline recognized participating workers by distributing shields, certificates, and cash prizes. This operational drive follows shortly after Hamilton-Manns officially took charge as CEO, bringing over three decades of commercial aviation experience that includes prior leadership positions at three separate airlines in Africa, Kazakhstan, and Oman.

The restructuring expert is tasked with enhancing service quality levels and reinforcing the national carrier's standing within the global aviation sector. This early step highlights management's dedication to implementing operational reforms and sustaining elevated benchmarks for passenger service and hygiene.

stories.title: South African Rand Rises as Global Oil Prices Soften
stories.summary:
The South African rand experienced an upward movement during early trading sessions, appreciating against the dollar as declining oil prices helped alleviate domestic inflation anxieties. Market participants simultaneously evaluated the outcomes of recent local municipal elections alongside ongoing discussions surrounding coalition governments.

Trading activity positioned the currency approximately 0.4 percent stronger than its previous close. Meanwhile, global oil prices stabilized following comments from US President Donald Trump indicating that new military actions against Iran remained unlikely, though lingering supply disruptions persisted after vessels near the Strait of Hormuz faced attacks.

Because South Africa functions as a net importer of fuel, the nation remains vulnerable to shifts in international crude prices, which can directly push up local fuel expenses, fuel inflation, and weaken the rand. Political uncertainty also weighed on the outlook, as the African National Congress faced notable setbacks in local municipal polls, complicating upcoming coalition negotiations for city administrations.

Analysts at ETM Analytics observed that overall risk balances continue to lean against the local currency, with investors monitoring offshore equity markets to gauge global risk appetite. Furthermore, the country's benchmark 2035 government bond remained unchanged in early deals, maintaining a yield of 8.3 percent as the political and economic landscape continues to navigate these complex variables.

stories.title: Greek Coast Guard Recovers Twelve Bodies from Boat Near Crete
stories.summary:
Greek authorities successfully retrieved the bodies of 12 deceased individuals and rescued 18 survivors from a vessel operating near the island of Crete. Officials stated that the exact cause of death for the deceased migrants remains undetermined at this time.

The rescue operation took place roughly 15 nautical miles away from the port of Kaloi Limenes. Coast guard personnel also intercepted and aided dozens of additional people across two separate incidents near Crete, with all survivors scheduled to be brought safely ashore.

Historically serving as a primary entry point to Europe for refugees and migrants originating from Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, Greece stood at the center of the 2015-2016 European migration crisis when nearly one million individuals arrived on its shores, primarily traveling through Turkey. Although total arrivals dropped significantly after Athens strengthened both sea and border patrols, recent months have witnessed an uptick in sea arrivals originating from northeastern Libya as migrants attempt dangerous journeys toward Europe via Crete.

stories.title: Ousted Bangladeshi Leader Seeks New Passport Ahead of Return
stories.summary:
Former Bangladeshi Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has formally requested a new passport and national identity card through her legal representation, signaling her intent to travel back from India where she has lived in self-imposed exile. The communication marks her first formal outreach since fleeing the country during a deadly uprising in 2024 that dismantled her extended tenure in power.

Lawyers representing the former leader at London-based Matrix Chambers submitted the application to Preeti Rahman, acting high commissioner at the diplomatic mission in New Delhi, urging expedited processing based on her nationality and international human rights obligations. The interim administration in Dhaka had previously revoked her travel documents and identity card following her departure.

Hasina was sentenced to death in absentia last November by a war-crimes court over her role in cracking down on student-led protests, accusations she has consistently rejected from abroad. Her legal team and aides indicated that a precise return date to face the court will be finalized once administrative formalities conclude, despite her political party, the Awami League, currently facing an official ban.

Her potential return carries the risk of intensifying political and legal divisions within Bangladesh as current leadership endeavors to stabilize the nation following years of turbulence. At the same time, her repatriation could potentially mend diplomatic relations between Dhaka and New Delhi, which suffered considerable strain after India granted her sanctuary.

stories.title: Krakow Mass Shooting Gunman Dies in Hospital, Police Confirm
stories.summary:
A young assailant responsible for killing six individuals in central Krakow passed away in the hospital early on Monday, according to law enforcement officials. The incident marked an unprecedented mass shooting event in Poland, unfolding when the 24-year-old opened fire on pedestrians from his vehicle at the historic main square. Authorities swiftly shot and apprehended the suspect just minutes after the attack commenced.

The perpetrator originated from Ostrowiec Swietokrzyski, a southeastern Polish community housing just under 60,000 residents. Government representatives indicated that the shooter might have drawn motivation from far-right ideology, though officials noted that further details remain forthcoming as inquiries continue.

Karolina Galecka, a spokeswoman for the interior ministry, addressed the media on Monday via radio station TOK FM regarding the physical evidence gathered from the scene. She stated that investigators are currently analyzing and interpreting multiple emblems discovered on the perpetrator's clothing.

While specialists review these various motif patches associated with the suspect's attire, officials have declined to offer additional comments. The broader investigation into the shooting and the underlying motives remains active as the nation processes the shock of the tragedy.

stories.title: Analysts React as Nvidia Board Investigates CEO Jensen Huang
stories.summary:
The board of Nvidia has initiated an inquiry into CEO Jensen Huang following media reports suggesting he was the target of a foreign intelligence operation orchestrated via a Chinese businesswoman who allegedly relayed information to Beijing. Industry experts and financial figures have subsequently offered divergent perspectives on the potential fallout for the world's second most valuable corporation.

Ryu Young-Ho, a senior analyst at NH Investment & Securities, suggested that the United States government has likely known about the situation for several months, mitigating immediate market impacts. However, he warned that extended internal reviews could jeopardize Nvidia's investment timelines and product schedules, carrying wider consequences for the semiconductor sector.

Conversely, Tesla investor Gary Black expressed skepticism regarding Huang's ability to retain his position, noting the absence of a natural internal successor. Black predicted that governance questions and conduct scrutiny will prompt numerous portfolio managers to trim their Nvidia shareholdings amid leadership uncertainty, placing temporary pressure on the stock.

Other public figures and market observers offered mixed commentary regarding the sensitive nature of the allegations. While some emphasized Huang's monumental contributions to the artificial intelligence landscape and voiced hope that the situation involves a simple personal affair rather than a national security threat, others stressed that the timing poses severe complications for tech markets and broader economic stability as upcoming earnings reports approach.

stories.title: Nvidia Shares Slip in After-Hours Trading Amid CEO Investigation
stories.summary:
Nvidia shares experienced a decline of approximately 3.4% during out-of-hours trading, settling near $180.30 following revelations that the chipmaker's board is investigating CEO Jensen Huang. The internal probe was launched after reports emerged indicating Huang maintained a relationship with Alice Huang, an unrelated former executive of Singapore-based Megaspeed who US authorities determined was a Chinese intelligence asset.

In response to the developments, Huang acknowledged to employees that he had been unfaithful to his wife. The scrutiny surrounding the world's most valuable chipmaker also affected executive travel plans, leading Madison Huang, the CEO's daughter and an Nvidia official, to cancel a scheduled visit to Seoul for an upcoming industry conference.

Prominent figures across finance and politics offered varied reactions to the unfolding situation. Billionaire investor Bill Ackman noted on social media that the allegations present a serious problem if proven to go beyond a personal affair, while Tesla CEO Elon Musk echoed sentiments regarding Huang's irreplaceable role in American AI leadership. US President Donald Trump stated he had not spoken with Huang directly but described him as an honorable person who likely has an explanation.

Market analysts suggested that while the boardroom turbulence creates uncertainty, the long-term impact on the artificial intelligence sector will depend heavily on whether leadership changes occur. Meanwhile, shares in key Asian semiconductor suppliers such as TSMC, Samsung Electronics, and SK Hynix rebounded during Monday trading following earlier market selloffs.

stories.title: Coco Gauff Outlasts Jessica Pegula in Thrilling WTA Finals Opener
stories.summary:
Coco Gauff secured a hard-fought victory over compatriot Jessica Pegula with a score of 6-4, 6-7(5), 6-2 during the opening day of the WTA Finals at Indian Wells on Sunday. In another match on the tournament's first day, Czech newcomer Linda Noskova defeated Marta Kostyuk 6-2, 6-4 to start her campaign strongly.

The encounter between Gauff and Pegula showcased high versatility and intense baseline rallies from the top two American players in the season-ending tournament. After Gauff claimed a tight opening set, Pegula seized momentum by winning the initial three games of the second set. Gauff fought back by saving multiple set points before Pegula ultimately claimed the second-set tiebreak.

Gauff regained control in the deciding third set, establishing a 5-2 lead before closing out the match on her third match point. Following the contest, Gauff noted that she competed with minimal preparation after a month-long break since the China Open, adding that the physical demands of the match completely tore up her tennis shoes.

In the day's other match, the eighth-ranked Linda Noskova applied consistent pressure from the baseline and net to overcome Kostyuk. Kostyuk entered the competition late as a replacement for top-ranked Elena Rybakina but struggled to find her rhythm against Noskova, who delivered 20 winners to seal the victory.

stories.title: Carlos Alcaraz Wins Paris Masters and Sets Sights on ATP Finals
stories.summary:
World number three Carlos Alcaraz captured his fifth title of the year by winning the Paris Masters on Sunday. He defeated American player Ben Shelton with scores of 7-6(5) and 7-5. The victory marked his third title since returning to the tour at the US Open following a nearly five-month break due to a wrist injury.

The seven-time Grand Slam champion stated that this was his best week of tennis since his return. He noted that he made a significant mental step forward during the tournament by overcoming difficult internal moments, managing his thoughts, and staying positive throughout his matches.

Alcaraz has never won the ATP Tour's season-ending tournament, having finished as runner-up in 2025 after a defeat against rival Jannik Sinner. Despite uncertainty about whether he will secure the trophy this year, he expressed a strong desire to win the event eventually and is heading into the tournament with high confidence.

The upcoming ATP Finals are scheduled to begin on Sunday in Turin. Alcaraz plans to use the information and experience gained in Paris to improve his performance during the prestigious season-ending competition.

stories.title: Australia Drops Marnus Labuschagne for Upcoming New Zealand Test Series
stories.summary:
Cricket Australia has dropped 32-year-old batter Marnus Labuschagne from the Test squad for the upcoming four-test home series against New Zealand. Selector George Bailey confirmed the decision on Monday, explaining that the move aims to give the player space following a prolonged slump in form and heavy speculation surrounding his position.

Labuschagne, once ranked as the world's top test batter, has gone 49 innings without scoring a century. During a recent tour of South Africa, where Australia lost the series 2-1, he recorded scores of zero and four in the final test. Since being dropped during the tour of the West Indies last year, he has averaged 23.66 and managed only two half-centuries across 10 tests.

While out of the national team, Labuschagne will return to captain Queensland in the Sheffield Shield. Selectors will evaluate potential top-order replacements ahead of the series opener in Perth on December 9, while leaving open the possibility that Labuschagne could regain his spot for future tours of India and England.

His omission creates further instability for Australia's top order, which has experienced constant changes since opening batsman David Warner retired nearly three years ago. Potential replacements and lineup adjustments are being considered, with the final squad to be determined after the next round of Shield matches.

stories.title: Pakistan Celebrates Iqbal Day and Launches Year-Long 150th Birth Anniversary Commemorations
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif paid tribute to Allama Muhammad Iqbal, known as the Poet of the East, on Iqbal Day and the 149th anniversary of his birth. In his message, the Prime Minister highlighted Iqbal's role in awakening political consciousness among Muslims in the Subcontinent and inspiring the struggle for an independent homeland.

The Prime Minister praised Iqbal's intellectual stature, wisdom, and contributions to Islamic thought, noting that his philosophy continues to guide individuals and societies. He emphasized concepts such as 'Khudi' for self-realization and the 'Shaheen' falcon as a symbol of courage and high aspirations, while stressing that Iqbal's teachings reject extremism and promote peace, tolerance, and human unity.

To mark the occasion, the government announced the beginning of a year-long commemoration leading up to Iqbal's 150th birth anniversary on November 9 of next year. A comprehensive schedule of national and international events has been launched, featuring academic conferences, literary festivals, research seminars, educational competitions, and cultural exhibitions.

These initiatives are designed to preserve Iqbal's intellectual legacy and integrate his principles into educational institutions and national development priorities. The government aims to encourage scholarly research, foster creative thinking, and strengthen national character by engaging the country's youth with the philosopher's timeless message.

stories.title: Passenger Train Collision in Egypt Leaves Seven Dead and Dozens Injured
stories.summary:
A passenger train collision occurred approximately 76 kilometers south of Cairo on Sunday, resulting in at least seven deaths and 112 injuries. According to Egypt's health ministry, the accident took place when a train traveling from Giza to Fayoum struck the rear of another train heading from Cairo to Aswan, causing several carriages to derail.

The state railway authority dispatched emergency crews to clear the wreckage and restore services along the Cairo-Upper Egypt line, though no timeline was provided for the resumption of normal operations. Egypt's public prosecutor’s office initiated investigations to identify the technical causes behind the crash on the railway network.

Following the incident, President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi ordered a swift investigation and stated that any individuals found negligent must be held accountable. The country operates one of the oldest and largest railway networks in the region, where accidents involving casualties have frequently occurred despite government investments of billions of Egyptian pounds to modernize infrastructure.

Historically, Egypt's railway system has experienced severe accidents, including the country's worst-ever rail disaster in 2002 when a fire swept through seven carriages of an overcrowded passenger service, resulting in at least 360 fatalities.

stories.title: China Factory-Gate Inflation Hits 4.5-Year High While Consumer Growth Cools
stories.summary:
China reported that its producer inflation accelerated in October to reach its fastest rate in nearly four and a half years. According to the National Bureau of Statistics, the producer price index climbed 5.7% compared to the previous year, surpassing the 5.0% increase recorded in September and exceeding a Reuters poll forecast of a 5.3% rise. This marked the largest annual climb since June 2022.

The surge in factory-gate costs was primarily driven by high global oil prices resulting from the Middle East conflict. These energy costs raised expenses for sectors such as coal mining, oil and natural gas extraction, chemicals, and other energy-intensive industries. However, these upstream pressures have not fully translated to everyday shoppers because sluggish domestic demand continues to constrain household spending in the world's second-largest economy.

Conversely, the consumer price index rose by 0.7% year-on-year in October, cooling from a 0.9% increase in September and coming in just below economists' expectations of a 0.8% rise. Core inflation, which strips out volatile food and energy costs, also eased from 1.0% in September down to 0.8% in October, highlighting lingering underlying price pressures.

Analysts note that while the conflict in the Middle East may keep inflation elevated in the coming months, its impact is expected to fade next year. Meanwhile, robust export growth has kept the economy moving without immediate broad policy stimulus, though a weak stock market and soft consumer sentiment continue to pose challenges for domestic economic stability.

stories.title: کراچی پولیس کی کارروائیاں: ایک ہفتے میں 880 سے زائد ملزمان گرفتار
stories.summary:
کراچی پولیس نے گزشتہ ایک ہفتے کے دوران شہر بھر میں کارروائیوں کے دوران 880 سے زائد ملزمان کو گرفتار کرنے کے اعداد و شمار جاری کر دیے ہیں۔ پولیس ترجمان کے مطابق اس دوران پولیس اور جرائم پیشہ افراد کے درمیان 43 مختلف مقابلے ہوئے۔

ان مقابلوں کے نتیجے میں 6 ڈاکو ہلاک اور 51 زخمی ہوئے جبکہ مجموعی طور پر 65 ملزمان کو حراست میں لیا گیا۔ پولیس کارروائیوں میں ہلاک ہونے والے افراد میں دو سگے بھائی بھی شامل ہیں جن کی لاشیں ضابطے کی کارروائی کے لیے اسپتال منتقل کر دی گئی ہیں۔

ترجمان نے مزید بتایا کہ کارروائیوں کے دوران ملزمان کے قبضے سے 132 مختلف اقسام کا غیر قانونی اسلحہ برآمد کیا گیا۔ اس کے علاوہ مختلف چھاپوں میں 20 کلوگرام سے زائد منشیات جن میں چرس، آئس اور ہیروئن شامل ہیں، بھی پولیس نے اپنے قبضے میں لے لیں۔

پولیس نے کارروائیوں کے دوران چھینے یا چرائے گئے سامان کی برآمدگی کے حوالے سے بتایا کہ اس مدت میں 39 موٹر سائیکلیں اور 3 کاریں بھی برآمد کی گئی ہیں۔ محکمہ پولیس کا کہنا ہے کہ شہر میں جرائم کے تدارک کے لیے اس طرح کی کارروائیاں بلا تعطل جاری رہیں گی۔

stories.title: Delhi Air Quality Plummets to Severe Levels Following Diwali Fireworks
stories.summary:
Air quality in India's capital city deteriorated sharply, plunging into the 'very poor' and 'severe' categories after residents set off fireworks to celebrate Diwali in direct violation of court orders. At 9 a.m. on Monday, Delhi recorded an overall air quality index of 370, which is classified as 'very poor' by the Central Pollution Control Board. Numerous locations across the metropolitan area of 20 million people registered readings exceeding 400, falling into the 'severe' classification.

Ahead of the celebrations, India's Supreme Court had mandated that only certified low-polluting firecrackers could be utilized during restricted hours over the holiday weekend. Despite these legal limitations, locals in both Delhi and Mumbai reported that firecrackers continued to detonate late into the night. Television broadcasts captured a dense layer of smog shrouding the India Gate landmark in central Delhi near major government buildings and parliament.

Live rankings from the Swiss group IQAir positioned Delhi as the third-most polluted city globally on Monday morning. Pakistan's Lahore held the top position with an alarming air quality index of 563, which is designated as hazardous. The worsening air conditions reflect a persistent seasonal cycle across northern India, where cold winter weather traps vehicle exhaust, construction dust, and smoke from agricultural waste burning.

Megacities like Delhi face magnified pollution challenges due to dense traffic volumes and continuous construction work, leaving local populations vulnerable to widespread respiratory ailments. In response to poor air quality levels persisting for over a week, local authorities implemented restrictions under a graded action plan on Friday, including a mandate for schools to switch to online classes.

stories.title: Trump Anticipates Trilateral Meeting With Xi and Putin at APEC Summit
stories.summary:
United States President Donald Trump announced on Sunday that he expects to hold discussions with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin during the upcoming APEC leaders' summit. Speaking to reporters prior to his return flight to Washington from Florida, Trump confirmed his travel plans to attend the summit scheduled for November 18-19 in the southern Chinese tech hub of Shenzhen.

The American leader outlined several key diplomatic objectives for the anticipated gathering, highlighting nuclear non-proliferation and ongoing international efforts to bring a close to the war in Iran. In October, Trump had previously expressed openness toward participating in three-way arms control discussions centered on denuclearization with both Xi and Putin.

Additional reports from The Wall Street Journal indicated that Putin has floated the idea of utilizing this trilateral summit format to address a potential resolution to the prolonged Russia-Ukraine conflict. Trump further remarked during an interview with CBS' 60 Minutes program that he believes a deal to end the war is close, predicting a slightly altered future territorial shape for Ukraine.

The upcoming meetings in Shenzhen bring together top global powers amidst existing bilateral trade discussions and heightened geopolitical tensions. The anticipated encounter provides a platform for leaders to address multiple international security concerns, ranging from Middle Eastern conflicts to strategic arms limitations and European stability.

stories.title: Private College Principal Booked in Bahawalpur for Alleged Student Rape
stories.summary:
Police in Musafirkhana have registered a formal case against the principal of a private college following allegations that he raped a first-year student. The incident reportedly took place in mauza Khanpur Mirchan, though law enforcement authorities confirmed that no arrests have been made thus far as the investigation continues.

According to the details provided in the police complaint by the victim's father, his 17-year-old daughter was waiting near the college gate to depart for home on November 3. The principal allegedly coerced her into his office and assaulted her. The father stated that the teenager disclosed the ordeal to her family immediately upon returning home.

The complainant added that members of his biradari initially discouraged him from approaching the police before he ultimately decided to file the official report. Local police officials from the Musafir Khana station confirmed that the case remains under active investigation while searching for the suspect.

In the wake of the incident, the victim's parents issued a public appeal directed to the Punjab chief minister. They requested immediate intervention and direct orders to the police force to ensure the swift apprehension of the accused principal.

stories.title: ANZ Shares Slip as CEO Warns Global Capital Competition Drives Rates
stories.summary:
Australia’s fourth-largest lender by market capitalisation, ANZ, experienced a 4.2% drop in its share price during afternoon trade following its financial results. The institution reported a 31% surge in annual cash profit to A$7.6 billion ($5.2 billion) for the year ending September 30, meeting the Visible Alpha consensus. However, the bank missed analyst expectations regarding net interest income and its net interest margin.

The net interest margin fell from 1.55% in 2025 to 1.53%, pressured by cross-division competition and the timing of Reserve Bank of Australia rate shifts. Furthermore, second-half net interest income of A$9 billion lagged behind analyst projections by approximately 2%. Meanwhile, operating expenses dropped 14% due to fewer restructuring charges and the absence of a prior Australian Securities and Investments Commission settlement.

Chief Executive Nuno Matos attributed the ongoing high interest rate environment to a global investment supercycle. He explained that governments in developed economies running budget deficits are competing directly with major corporations, renewables, defence, and artificial intelligence for long-term capital. Matos stated that this heavy funding demand creates inflation and maintains elevated borrowing costs.

Looking ahead, ANZ projects that the Australian economy will grow by 1.6% next year, improving upon the 1.1% expectation for the current year. Matos expressed confidence that the national economy can successfully navigate a benign environment, while noting that the Australian retail division's annual cash profit grew to A$1.71 billion from A$771 million due to higher home loan volumes.

stories.title: اینویڈیا کے سربراہ جینسن ہوانگ کے خلاف مبینہ چینی جاسوس سے تعلق پر تحقیقات شروع
stories.summary:
امریکی ٹیکنالوجی کمپنی اینویڈیا نے اپنے چیف ایگزیکٹو جینسن ہوانگ کے ایک مبینہ چینی جاسوس خاتون کے ساتھ تعلق کی تحقیقات کا آغاز کر دیا ہے۔ دنیا کی سب سے قیمتی کمپنیوں میں شمار ہونے والی اس فرم کے بورڈ آف ڈائریکٹرز کا کہنا ہے کہ اگرچہ اس بات کا کوئی ثبوت نہیں ملا کہ کمپنی کے راز یا قومی سلامتی متاثر ہوئی ہے، تاہم تمام دستیاب معلومات کا جائزہ لیا جائے گا۔

نیویارک ٹائمز کی ایک رپورٹ کے مطابق، امریکی انٹیلی جنس حکام کا ماننا ہے کہ سنگاپور کی ڈیٹا سینٹر کمپنی میگا سپیڈ سے وابستہ کاروباری خاتون ایلس ہوانگ (جنہیں ہوانگ لی بھی کہا جاتا ہے) بیجنگ کے لیے جاسوسی کرتی تھیں۔ حکام کے مطابق نگرانی کے دوران ایلس ہوانگ اور ایک امریکی شہری کے درمیان رابطوں کا پتہ چلا، جس کی شناخت بعد میں جینسن ہوانگ کے طور پر ہوئی۔

دوسری جانب جینسن ہوانگ نے اعتراف کیا کہ وہ اپنی اہلیہ سے بے وفائی کے مرتکب ہوئے ہیں اور اپنے اس عمل پر بیوی بچوں سے معافی مانگتے ہوئے انہوں نے تحقیقات کی مکمل حمایت اور تعاون کا یقین دلایا ہے۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ وہ اینویڈیا کے تحفظ اور امریکہ کی قومی سلامتی کی حمایت کے لیے پوری طرح پرعزم ہیں۔

اس معاملے کے بعد امریکی صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ نے تبصرہ کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ وہ ہوانگ کو ایک اچھے اور باعزت انسان کے طور پر جانتے ہیں۔ دوسری طرف امریکی کانگریس کے کچھ ریپبلکن ارکان نے اینویڈیا کے سی ای او کو طلب کر کے سکیورٹی پروٹوکولز پر بریفنگ دینے کا مطالبہ کیا ہے، کیونکہ اینویڈیا کے اے آئی چپس امریکہ اور چین کے درمیان ٹیکنالوجی کی جنگ میں انتہائی مرکزی حیثیت رکھتے ہیں۔

stories.title: Bangladesh External Debt Triples in Decade Amid Rising Repayment Pressures
stories.summary:
According to the World Bank’s International Debt Report 2026, Bangladesh’s total foreign debt expanded to $113 billion by the end of 2025, marking a nearly threefold increase from roughly $38 billion in 2015. This rate represents the third-largest debt stock in South Asia and a steeper decade-long rise than any other regional nation except the Maldives. Despite the increase, the country's debt burden relative to export earnings remains lower than Pakistan, Sri Lanka, and Bhutan, though higher than India and Nepal.

For every $100 in annual earnings, Bangladesh carries $210 in total debt and allocates $16 annually toward debt servicing. In 2025, debt servicing consumed 16% of the country's export earnings, a 3.1 percentage point decrease from the previous year. The nation's debt-to-GNI ratio stands at 24%, slightly above the South Asian aggregate of 21%. However, external debt equals 210% of annual exports, leaving the country vulnerable because its export base is small and relies heavily on readymade garments.

Economists have warned that debt pressures will mount as global financing conditions tighten. Zahid Hussain, a former lead economist at the World Bank’s Dhaka office, cautioned that unmanaged borrowing could eventually lead to a crisis similar to Sri Lanka's. Prof Mustafizur Rahman from the Centre for Policy Dialogue noted that government debt servicing is projected to climb from $4.9 billion last fiscal year to $7.6 billion by 2029 due to rising interest rates and shrinking grace periods.

Globally, developing countries' foreign debt rose 5.5% to $9.4 trillion in 2025, representing the fastest growth rate since 2021. Low and middle-income countries paid $1.4 trillion in principal and interest during 2025, reflecting the fifth consecutive annual increase. Experts emphasize that Bangladesh must increase exports, improve domestic resource mobilization, and secure more concessional financing to manage its future obligations.

stories.title: Cryptocurrencies Hit Two-Month Lows on Regulatory Fears and Exchange Heist
stories.summary:
Cryptocurrencies experienced a sharp decline in late Sunday trade, pushing major digital assets like Bitcoin and Ether to their lowest price points in over two months. The market downturn was primarily driven by investor concerns that a Democratic Party-controlled United States Congress would introduce stricter regulations on the asset class.

Bitcoin, the oldest and largest cryptocurrency by market capitalisation, dropped by more than 2% to trade at $73,708. This marks its lowest valuation since August. Similarly, Ether fell approximately 5% to reach $2,223, also touching its lowest level since August.

Market sentiment has been heavily rattled in recent trading sessions by two major developments. These include a massive $6 billion heist at Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, which subsequently reported that customers withdrew a net $4.7 billion following the security breach.

Additionally, the market downturn coincided with the election of high-profile political critics to office during the previous week's US midterms. These combined factors amplified investor anxiety regarding future oversight and security across the global digital asset ecosystem.

stories.title: Trump Praises Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Amid Foreign Spying Probe
stories.summary:
US President Donald Trump spoke to reporters in Chicago on Sunday regarding Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, describing him as an honorable individual who has made tremendous contributions to the United States. Trump's remarks followed reports that Nvidia has launched an internal investigation to determine whether Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence operation involving a Chinese businesswoman accused of passing information to Beijing.

Despite the ongoing allegations, Trump confirmed that he had not discussed the matter directly with Huang. He expressed confidence in the executive, stating that he considers him a fine person who has likely got a valid explanation for the situation, while acknowledging that external observers can never fully know behind-the-scenes circumstances.

Nvidia announced its probe on Sunday after media reports surfaced detailing a close relationship between Huang and the Chinese businesswoman in question. Trump praised Huang's corporate leadership, noting that the CEO has done an amazing job for the country.

When questioned by reporters about whether Huang would accompany him on an upcoming presidential trip to Asia the following week, Trump indicated that he remained uncertain about the travel plans. However, the president explicitly affirmed that he would certainly be willing to include Huang on the journey.

stories.title: Indian Shares Edge Lower After Record Winning Streak Led by Tech and Pharma
stories.summary:
Indian stock markets experienced a slight downturn on Monday, with the Nifty 50 and Sensex both falling by 0.2% to reach 24,931.2 and 80,837.24 respectively by 9:35 a.m. IST. This movement serves as a consolidation period following a significant market rally that saw indexes jump approximately 10.5% over seven consecutive sessions leading up to Friday. That preceding surge marked the longest winning streak of the year for Indian shares, driven heavily by falling crude prices, easing oil concerns, and robust foreign investments. According to official figures, foreign investors have already purchased over $4.1 billion in Indian shares this November, representing the largest monthly inflows since September 2024.

Market experts note that investors are currently weighing the potential for additional gains against the likelihood of near-term profit-taking as the new trading week begins. Among major market segments, ten out of sixteen sectors traded lower, while broader small-cap and mid-cap indexes registered declines of 0.1% and 0.3% respectively. Meanwhile, Brent crude futures hovered near $98 per barrel following remarks from US President Donald Trump indicating it was unlikely he would order fresh attacks on Iran amid ongoing peace talks.

Sector performance varied significantly, with the pharmaceutical index climbing 1.6% thanks to a strong showing by Divi's Laboratories. The drugmaker saw its shares jump 4.6%, extending a previous 7.5% gain from a special Diwali trading session on Sunday after reporting a 64% year-on-year increase in quarterly profit. Conversely, information technology stocks dropped 1.3%, whereas heavyweight financial shares managed a modest gain of 0.5%.

This market adjustment occurs alongside broader economic observations across Asian markets, which experienced a rebound following a turbulent week. That earlier volatility across tech-heavy Asian markets was largely triggered by doubts surrounding consumer demand for computer chips.

stories.title: بھارتی فوج کے نظم وضبط اور عسکری پروٹوکول پر آر ایس ایس کی سیاست کے گہرے اثرات
stories.summary:
بھارتی فوج کے اعلیٰ عسکری نظام اور نظم و ضبط میں حکمران جماعت بی جے پی اور آر ایس ایس کے نظریات سے جڑے سیاستدانوں کے اثرات میں نمایاں اضافہ دیکھا جا رہا ہے۔ بھارتی نیوز ایجنسی اے این آئی کی ایک وائرل ویڈیو میں دیکھا گیا ہے کہ بھارتی آرمی چیف اور دیگر اعلیٰ جرنیل وزیر دفاع سے ملاقات کی خاطر قطار میں کھڑے ہیں جبکہ وہاں موجود سیکیورٹی کمانڈوز انہیں گھور رہے ہیں اور انہوں نے عسکری روایت کے برخلاف سلیوٹ تک نہیں کیا۔

آر ایس ایس کی ہندوتوا سوچ سے متاثرہ وزیر دفاع کے ساتھ فوٹو سیشن کے دوران بھارتی جرنیلوں کا بار بار اٹھنا اور بیٹھنا روایتی فوجی آداب اور پیشہ ورانہ تربیت کے واضح فقدان کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ معروف بھارتی جریدے 'دی وائر' کے مطابق انڈینائزیشن کے نام پر بھارتی فوج کو آر ایس ایس کے نظریے کے تابع اور ہم آہنگ کرنے کی مسلسل کوششیں کی جا رہی ہیں تاکہ عسکری ادارے پر سیاسی نظریات کو مسلط کیا جا سکے۔

stories.title: Ousted Bangladesh Leader Sheikh Hasina Seeks Passport to Facilitate Return
stories.summary:
Ousted former Bangladeshi Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has formally requested a new passport and identity card from her self-imposed exile in India. In a letter dated Monday sent through her legal representatives at London-based Matrix Chambers to Preeti Rahman, the acting high commissioner at Bangladesh's embassy in Delhi, Hasina asked for the documents to be processed expeditiously based on her Bangladeshi nationality and international human rights obligations. This development represents her first direct communication since fleeing the country in 2024 and marks the clearest step yet toward executing her stated plan to return to Bangladesh in December.

The request follows actions by the interim government and other authorities to revoke her existing Bangladeshi passport and National Identity Card. Hasina previously stated to Reuters that her intention in returning is to surrender before a court, with her aides noting that a specific date will be announced once remaining formalities are finalized. Last November, a war-crimes court in Bangladesh sentenced Hasina to death in her absence for her role in ordering a deadly crackdown on a student-led uprising, though she has consistently denied these allegations from exile.

The potential return of Hasina threatens to introduce fresh political and legal complications in Bangladesh, where her political organization, the Awami League, has been banned. Previously the country's largest political party, many of its members are currently jailed or living in exile. While Hasina ruled Bangladesh for two decades across multiple terms and retains support among segments of the population, her return could deepen domestic political divisions as Dhaka attempts to maintain stability following more than two years of severe upheaval.

At the same time, her repatriation could impact diplomatic relations between Dhaka and New Delhi. Ties between the two nations became heavily strained after India granted Hasina refuge following the collapse of her administration. Spokespeople for Prime Minister Tarique Rahman in Dhaka and officials at the Delhi embassy did not immediately respond to requests for comment regarding the passport application.

stories.title: Pakistan Advances Toward 2028 Riba Elimination Through Financial Sector Reforms
stories.summary:
Pakistan's constitutional requirement to eliminate Riba by January 1, 2028, provides a critical framework for transforming the nation's financial architecture rather than merely replacing conventional banking contracts with Islamic alternatives. The Ministry of Finance’s Post-2027 Financial System Strategy outlines a comprehensive road map to shift the economy toward Shariah-compliant systems, addressing savings mobilization, government expenditures, enterprise support, and the fair distribution of economic opportunities.

Recent data highlights the rapid expansion of the Islamic banking sector within the country. According to the State Bank of Pakistan's June 2026 Bulletin, Islamic banking assets expanded by Rs2.88 trillion over two quarters to reach Rs16.35 trillion by June 30, 2026. During this period, deposits climbed to Rs12.67 trillion, while the financing portfolio reached Rs6.01 trillion. Overall, Islamic banking currently accounts for 29.2% of total deposits and 39.1% of financing. Sovereign Sukuk issuance has similarly surpassed the Rs10 trillion threshold, indicating growing public engagement and institutional capacity.

The finance ministry's strategy dictates that all fresh domestic government financing following 2027 will rely on Shariah-compliant instruments, while outstanding conventional public debt will be phased out upon maturity. Implementing this vision requires coordinated milestones involving the finance ministry, the State Bank of Pakistan, and the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan. Furthermore, the transition should prompt broader fiscal reforms to improve revenue mobilization, address loss-making public-sector enterprises, and foster a deeper domestic Sukuk market capable of supporting long-term investments in energy, transport, water, and infrastructure projects.

Achieving a resilient and sustainable Islamic financial system depends on four essential reforms. First, commercial, banking, insolvency, and securities laws must establish legal certainty for Shariah-compliant transactions. Second, tax regulations must not penalize Islamic structures involving multiple contractual steps. Third, the central bank must build reliable Shariah-compliant liquidity operations and interbank markets. Finally, institutions must strengthen professional capacity, governance, and transparency. Internationally, global Islamic finance assets reached $6.5 trillion in 2025 and are projected to exceed $10.5 trillion by 2030, according to the London Stock Exchange Islamic Finance Development Report 2026, positioning Pakistan among leading global markets if it maintains institutional depth and rigorous public oversight.

stories.title: Nvidia Board Investigates CEO Jensen Huang Following Foreign Intelligence Allegations
stories.summary:
Nvidia announced on Sunday that its board of directors is launching an independent investigation into whether CEO Jensen Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence operation. A committee of independent directors, supported by outside legal counsel, will oversee the inquiry following media reports alleging that Huang had a close relationship with a Chinese businesswoman who authorities concluded was an intelligence asset for Beijing. The individual, Alice Huang, is a former executive of the Singapore-based firm Megaspeed, which purchases advanced AI chips from Nvidia and has faced United States scrutiny over suspicions of aiding Beijing in bypassing export controls.

In addition to the board probe, Huang sent a message to Nvidia employees admitting to marital infidelity and taking full responsibility for his actions, stating that he was deeply sorry for hurting his family. Nvidia leadership stated that the board has no reason to believe US national security or company secrets were compromised, and emphasized that Huang fully supports the review and remains committed to leading the company without interruption. US President Donald Trump commented on Sunday that he had not spoken to Huang regarding the allegations, describing him as an honorable person who has done an incredible job. Meanwhile, top Republican lawmakers in the US House of Representatives have previously called on Huang to brief Congress to address national security concerns regarding Chinese access to sensitive American technology.

The investigation arrives at a challenging time for the $4.5 trillion chipmaker, whose stock has experienced sharp declines amid broader market anxieties over the sustainability and spending pace of the artificial intelligence boom. Analysts warn that the controversy could create an ongoing negative impact on Nvidia's stock price and spark congressional inquiries, particularly given Huang's central role in the company's multi-decade rise as a dominant supplier of AI chips. Despite the governance and sentiment risks introduced by the probe, analysts note that the long-term trajectory of the firm will largely depend on whether the board investigation results in leadership changes at the top.

stories.title: Pakistan Ports Attract Record Vessel Calls Amid Middle East Crisis
stories.summary:
Pakistan’s ports have experienced a significant surge in vessel calls and transshipment volumes, capitalizing on shifting trade routes caused by Middle East disruptions. To turn these short-term gains into lasting advantages, the government introduced transshipment incentives in August 2026 under a unified regulatory framework announced by Federal Minister for Maritime Affairs Junaid Anwar Chaudhry. Measures include slab-based concessions, wharfage rebates, free terminal storage, and reduced terminal handling charges by private operators such as KICT, SAPT, KGTL, and QICT. Customs reforms have also enabled off-dock transshipment, sea-to-air transfers, and faster cargo clearance.

International interest has grown, with Mediterranean Shipping Company launching a weekly direct service linking Karachi with Europe, alongside a new feeder service to Khor Fakkan, UAE. Dredging of Karachi Port's navigation channel, expected to finish by December 2026, will accommodate larger vessels. Consequently, Karachi Port climbed 30 places to 69th in the 2025 Container Port Performance Index, while its Port Liner Shipping Connectivity Index rose from 309 in the first quarter of 2026 to 357 in the third quarter. Pakistan's overall global Liner Shipping Connectivity Index ranking advanced from 35th to 34th.

Operational performance remains strong following a record fiscal year 2025-26, which saw cargo handling reach 55.438 million tonnes and container throughput hit 2.749 million TEUs from over 2,100 vessel calls. Growth continued from July to October 2026, with total cargo throughput rising 3.8 percent to 19.286 million tonnes. Additionally, the Karachi Port Trust contributes substantially to public revenues, paying 12 billion rupees annually in federal taxes and 5 billion rupees to Sindh, while the provincial government collects 160 billion rupees via the Sindh Infrastructure Development Cess.

Despite these operational gains, KPT Chairman retired Rear Admiral Shahid Ahmed highlighted that dilapidated access roads linking the ports to industrial zones and national highways continue to inflate logistics costs. He proposed allocating 50 percent of the Sindh Infrastructure Development Cess revenue toward upgrading these roads. Additional expansion projects, such as bunkering services launched with Vitol in November 2025 that have served over 170 vessels, point to further modernization. Industry stakeholders like Muhammad Rajpar and M H Lodhi have welcomed the regulatory progress, reduced tariffs, and enhanced international collaboration.

Sustaining this momentum is crucial for Pakistan to transform into a reliable and competitive maritime hub. Senior officials stress that the primary goal is to leverage these regional disruptions into long-term trade and investment rather than temporary success, relying heavily on continued infrastructure improvements, digital integration, and robust public-private cooperation.

stories.title: یوکرین کا روس کی دوسری بڑی آئل ریفائنری پر ڈرون حملہ، آگ بھڑک اٹھی
stories.summary:
روس کے شمال مغربی علاقے لینن گراڈ کے شہر کریشی میں یوکرین کے ڈرون حملے کے نتیجے میں ملک کی دوسری بڑی آئل ریفائنری میں شدید آگ بھڑک اٹھی، جس سے اس اہم صنعتی تنصیب کو کافی نقصان پہنچا۔ خبر رساں اداروں رائٹرز اور آسٹریلین براڈکاسٹنگ کارپوریشن کے مطابق یہ حملہ پیر 9 نومبر 2026 کی علی الصبح کیا گیا، جس میں کیریشی آئل ریفائنری کو براہِ راست نشانہ بنایا گیا۔

حملے کے دوران گرنے والے ڈرون کے ملبے کی زد میں ایک قریبی رہائشی عمارت آ گئی جس کے نتیجے میں ایک خاتون ہلاک ہو گئی جبکہ کئی مقامات پر دیگر عمارتوں کو بھی نقصان پہنچا۔ نشانہ بننے والی کیریشی ریفائنری روس کی دوسری بڑی تیل صاف کرنے والی تنصیب ہے جہاں سالانہ تقریباً 2 کروڑ میٹرک ٹن یعنی یومیہ چار لاکھ بیرل خام تیل پراسیس کرنے کی صلاحیت موجود ہے اور یہ روس کے شمال مغربی علاقوں میں پٹرول، ڈیزل اور فضائی ایندھن کی فراہمی کے لیے انتہائی اہمیت کی حامل ہے۔

stories.title: علامہ اقبالؒ کو نوجوان نسل پر غیر معمولی اعتماد تھا: وزیرِ اعظم
stories.summary:
وزیرِ اعظم شہباز شریف نے علامہ محمد اقبال کے یومِ پیدائش کے موقع پر اپنے پیغام میں انہیں خراجِ عقیدت پیش کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ مفکرِ پاکستان کو نوجوان نسل پر غیر معمولی اعتماد تھا اور وہ انہیں قوم کے مستقبل کا معمار مانتے تھے۔ انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ علامہ اقبال کے اسلامی افکار مسلمانوں کو عملی رہنمائی فراہم کرتے ہیں اور ان کے کلام نے برِصغیر کے مسلمانوں کو اپنے مستقبل کا فیصلہ خود کرنے کی طاقت دی تھی۔

اس موقع پر پاک بحریہ کے چاق و چوبند دستے نے مزار اقبال پر اعزازی گارڈز کے فرائض سنبھال لیے۔ وزیرِ اعظم کا کہنا تھا کہ نوجوانوں کے لیے علامہ اقبال کے تصورِ شاہین میں جرأت، خود مختاری اور حصولِ کمال کا عزم چھپا ہوا ہے۔ ان کے شعری مجموعے جیسے بانگ درا، بال جبریل اور ضرب کلیم نوجوانوں میں امید کی کرن پیدا کرتے ہیں۔

وزیرِ اعظم نے اس بات پر بھی زور دیا کہ فکرِ اقبال پائیدار قومی ترقی کے لیے امن، سماجی ہم آہنگی، رواداری اور انصاف کی داعی ہے۔ اسلامی تعلیمات کی فکری جہتوں کو موضوع بحث بنانے والے مفکرِ پاکستان کے منفرد تشخص کے شعور نے حصولِ وطن کی جدوجہد میں کلیدی کردار ادا کیا تھا، جس سے قوم کو درست سمت ملی۔

stories.title: سعودی پاکستان پرائیویٹ ایکویٹی فنڈ کے قیام کی مفاہمتی یادداشت پر دستخط
stories.summary:
سعودی پاکستان جوائنٹ بزنس کونسل نے پیر کے روز کراچی میں منعقدہ ایک تقریب کے دوران سعودی پاکستان پرائیویٹ ایکویٹی فنڈ کے قیام کے لیے ایک مفاہمتی یادداشت پر دستخط کیے۔ اس موقع پر خطاب کرتے ہوئے شہزادہ منصور بن محمد آل سعود نے کہا کہ دونوں ممالک کے درمیان گہرے برادرانہ رشتے پائے جاتے ہیں اور یہ فنڈ اس تعلق کو ایک مضبوط تجارتی بنیاد فراہم کرے گا۔ تقریب میں عارف حبیب گروپ کے سربراہ عارف حبیب نے بھی شرکت کی اور اس اقدام کو منافع بخش سرمایہ کاری کے لیے اہم قرار دیا۔

اس مجوزہ مشترکہ فنڈ کا حجم سیکڑوں ملین روپے ہے جس میں سعودی اور پاکستانی نجی سرمایہ کار مساوی حصہ ڈالیں گے۔ فنڈ کی سرمایہ کاری کا 75 فیصد حصہ پاکستان اور 25 فیصد حصہ سعودی عرب کے منصوبوں میں لگایا جائے گا۔ یہ فنڈ زراعت، کان کنی، تعمیرات اور دیگر تیزی سے ترقی کرنے والے نجی کاروباروں میں سرمایہ کاری کا ارادہ رکھتا ہے تاکہ معاشی ترقی کو فروغ دیا جا سکے۔

اس فنڈ کے ذریعے حکومتِ پاکستان کے لینڈ بینک کو منیٹائز کرنے کے پروگرام کے تحت ہوائی اڈوں، موٹرویز، بندرگاہوں اور بحری شعبے کے تجارتی منصوبوں کا بھی جائزہ لیا جائے گا تا کہ غیر فعال سرکاری اراضی کو پیداواری سرمایہ کاری میں بدلا جا سکے۔ اس کے علاوہ مقدس شہروں سمیت سعودی عرب بھر میں بھی تجارتی سرمایہ کاری کے مواقع تلاش کیے جائیں گے۔

تقریب میں دونوں ممالک کے کونسل اراکین نے شرکت کی جبکہ پاکستان کی جانب سے فاطمہ گروپ کے چیئرمین اور کونسل کے شریک چیئرمین فواد مختار نے ورچوئلی شرکت کی۔ اس شراکت داری کا مقصد دونوں ممالک کے عوام کو فائدہ پہنچانا اور غیر ملکی سرمایہ کاروں کا اعتماد بحال کرنے کی جانب پہلا قدم اٹھانا ہے۔

stories.title: بنوں کے علاقے جھنڈوخیل میں فائرنگ سے دو بھائیوں سمیت تین افراد جاں بحق
stories.summary:
بنوں کے علاقے جھنڈوخیل میں پرانی دشمنی کی بنیاد پر فریقین کے درمیان فائرنگ کا ایک پرتشدد واقعہ پیش آیا ہے۔ اس مسلح تصادم کے نتیجے میں تین افراد موقع پر ہی جاں بحق ہو گئے، جن میں دو سگے بھائی بھی شامل ہیں۔

واقعے کی اطلاع ملنے کے بعد پولیس نے فوری طور پر کارروائی کرتے ہوئے جاں بحق ہونے والے تمام افراد کی لاشیں اسپتال منتقل کر دیں۔ پولیس کا ابتدائی تفتیش کے حوالے سے کہنا ہے کہ یہ خونی تصادم دیرینہ دشمنی کا شاخسانہ ہے، اور اس سلسلے میں مزید تحقیقات کا آغاز کر دیا گیا ہے۔

stories.title: Asian Stocks Recover From AI Sell-Off While Dollar Strengthens
stories.summary:
Asian equity markets and United States stock futures experienced an upbeat rebound at the start of the week following a turbulent period marked by severe AI-related sell-offs. MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan increased by 2 percent after dropping 4.6 percent the previous week. Japan's Nikkei index gained 3.5 percent, and Korean shares advanced 1.8 percent. Meanwhile, Taiwan's benchmark rose more than 6 percent after suffering its steepest weekly drop in two decades due to investor fears regarding artificial intelligence profitability and infrastructure demand following Democratic wins in US midterms.

US stock futures for the S&P 500 e-minis traded 0.6 percent higher, following a Wall Street rally on Friday that helped calm investor nerves. Analysts noted that dip-buyers are stepping in during a data-light week, focusing primarily on price actions rather than broader fundamentals. Upcoming tech earnings reports from companies such as CoreWeave, Applied Materials, and Cisco Systems will test AI profit expectations against massive build-out costs. Additionally, an investigation by Nvidia regarding its CEO Jensen Huang potentially being the target of a foreign spying effort introduced further volatility, causing Nvidia shares to decline about 3.5 percent in after-hours trading.

In the commodities market, Brent crude oil fell to $98.2 per barrel after US President Donald Trump stated on Sunday that new attacks on Iran are highly unlikely while conflict-resolution talks progress. Conversely, China reported that factory-gate inflation accelerated to its fastest pace in over four years, even as consumer inflation cooled in October due to weak domestic demand and higher oil costs.

In the United States, a blowout jobs report on Friday showed employers added 165,000 jobs last month, more than double economists' expectations. This strong employment data bolstered expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates by at least 25 basis points at its December meeting, with CME FedWatch Tool pricing placing the probability near 80 percent. Federal Reserve officials, including New York Fed President John Williams, emphasized that while economic growth remains resilient, inflation is still too high and must return to 2 percent.

Driven by the strong payroll data and anticipated rate hikes, the US dollar registered its biggest single-day gain in five months. The dollar index hovered around 102.2, while the euro remained near $1.1148 and the Japanese yen strengthened slightly to 158.215 per dollar. In cryptocurrencies, Bitcoin added over 1 percent to reach $74,934 and ether held steady at $2,140, recovering from multi-month lows driven by regulatory concerns.

stories.title: راولپنڈی ٹیسٹ میں سری لنکا کی جانب سے چار فاسٹ بولرز کا انتخاب
stories.summary:
راولپنڈی میں جاری ٹیسٹ میچ میں سری لنکا کی ٹیم نے چار فاسٹ بولرز کو میدان میں اتارا ہے جسے کرکٹ مبصرین کی جانب سے ایک غلطی قرار دیا جا رہا ہے۔ مبصرین کا کہنا ہے کہ گزشتہ ورلڈ ٹیسٹ چیمپیئن شپ کے دوران پاکستان نے بھی اسی میدان پر بنگلادیش کے خلاف چار فاسٹ بولرز کھلائے تھے جس کے نتیجے میں قومی ٹیم کو شکست کا سامنا کرنا پڑا تھا اور سلو اوور ریٹ کی وجہ سے پوائنٹس بھی گنوانے پڑے تھے۔

سری لنکا کی جانب سے اتنے زیادہ فاسٹ بولرز کھلانے کے باوجود ٹیم کو اب تک خاطر خواہ کامیابی حاصل نہیں ہو سکی ہے۔ دوسری طرف اس میچ میں پاکستان نے اپنی ٹیم میں تین فاسٹ بولرز اور تین آل راؤنڈرز کو شامل کیا ہے جو تینوں اسپن بولنگ کی صلاحیت رکھتے ہیں۔

میچ کے دوران پاکستان نے چائے کے وقفے تک سری لنکا کے خلاف تین وکٹوں کے نقصان پر 214 رنز بنا لیے تھے۔ مبصرین کے مطابق سری لنکا کی یہ حکمت عملی پچھلے تجربات کی روشنی میں کارآمد ثابت نہیں ہو رہی۔

اس سیریز کے دوران دونوں ٹیموں کی حکمت عملی پر ماہرین مسلسل تبصرہ کر رہے ہیں۔ راولپنڈی کی اس پچ پر بولنگ کے انتخاب کو لے کر کرکٹ کے حلقوں میں کافی بحث جاری ہے۔

stories.title: US Dollar Sustains Payroll Gains As New Zealand Markets Watch Elections
stories.summary:
The US dollar maintained positions close to multi-month highs against major international currencies following robust domestic employment data that reinforced expectations of upcoming Federal Reserve interest rate hikes. The US dollar index, which tracks the greenback against six major peers including the euro, held steady at 102.20 early Monday following a roughly 0.7 percent jump on Friday. That surge was triggered by October data showing accelerated job growth and a declining unemployment rate.

Against European and Asian counterparts, the dollar retained significant gains. The euro edged up 0.1 percent to $1.11485, remaining close to a multi-month low near $1.1105 reached in May 2025. The Australian dollar rose 0.3 percent to $0.6875 after tumbling more than 1 percent on Friday to its lowest level since March 31. Meanwhile, the Japanese yen eased 0.2 percent to 158.185 per dollar, even as Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda noted that underlying inflation is expected to stay near the 2 percent target alongside some upside risks.

Futures markets indicate roughly 79 percent odds that the US Federal Reserve will raise interest rates during its December 9 meeting, up from 71 percent the previous week. This shift comes despite a recent global tech stock sell-off driven by investor concerns over artificial intelligence investment, profitability, and potential regulatory crackdowns following Democratic victories in US midterm elections. Barclays strategists noted that strong broader economic data momentum continues to outweigh regulatory fears and supports the dollar's market appeal.

Comments from several Federal Reserve officials on Friday reinforced expectations for monetary tightening. New York Fed President John Williams highlighted that economic growth remains resilient despite successive shocks, making it essential to bring inflation back down to 2 percent. St. Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem and San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly similarly stressed that inflation remains a primary concern and that further rate hikes are likely necessary despite the painful tech stock correction.

In New Zealand, the national currency climbed 0.4 percent to $0.5557, bouncing back from a seven-month low of $0.5529 recorded late last week. Preliminary election results showed Prime Minister Christopher Luxon’s National Party, alongside ACT New Zealand and New Zealand First, securing 67 seats in the 131-seat parliament, narrowly surpassing the 66 seats required for a majority. However, with nearly 400,000 votes remaining uncounted, official results and formal coalition negotiations are delayed until late November.

stories.title: Indian Rupee Reaches Six-Month High, Stirring Debate Over RBI Intervention
stories.summary:
The Indian rupee extended its ongoing rally on Monday, touching an intraday high of 93.70 per dollar to reach a six-month high. This appreciation follows a more than 1 percent rally last week and marks a total gain of nearly 3.25 percent over the past month, pulling the currency away from recent historic lows. The strong performance has turned market focus toward the Reserve Bank of India and potential dollar-buying interventions to manage foreign exchange reserves.

Analysts, including Madhavi Arora of Emkay Global, expect the Reserve Bank of India to utilize sustained dollar inflows to rebuild its foreign exchange buffers rather than allowing the rupee to appreciate too sharply. India's foreign exchange reserves have previously fallen by $68 billion from their peak. Additionally, the central bank’s net short dollar position in the forward market expanded to an all-time high of nearly $240 billion in September, creating substantial future dollar commitments that cap the currency's upward momentum alongside ongoing current account funding needs.

Several favorable economic factors have supported the rupee's recovery in recent weeks. A notable decline in crude oil prices has eased pressure on the domestic currency, while foreign investors have returned to domestic equities. Furthermore, recent monetary and regulatory measures by the central bank have helped alleviate the persistent supply-demand imbalance in the foreign exchange market, where robust import demand for dollars had previously outstripped exporter supply.

With the rupee strengthening toward a six-month peak, bankers and financial traders are closely monitoring the specific exchange rate threshold at which the Reserve Bank of India will intervene to purchase US dollars. Absorbing excess dollar supply would allow the central bank to replenish its depleted reserves and effectively manage its massive forward market exposures, balancing the competing objectives of currency stability and reserve accumulation.

stories.title: سینیگال کے ساحل پر تارکینِ وطن کی کشتی الٹنے سے پینتیس افراد ہلاک
stories.summary:
مغربی افریقی ملک سینیگال کے شمال مغربی ساحل کے قریب یورپ جانے کی کوشش کرنے والے تارکینِ وطن کی ایک کشتی سمندر میں الٹ گئی جس کے نتیجے میں کم از کم 35 افراد ہلاک ہو گئے۔ حادثے کے بعد صرف ایک شخص کو زندہ بچایا جا سکا جبکہ متعدد افراد تاحال لاپتا ہیں۔

خبر رساں اداروں کے مطابق یہ حادثہ 6 یا 7 نومبر 2026ء کو کیبیمیر کے علاقے کے ساحل کے قریب پیش آیا۔ کشتی میں سوار افراد غیر قانونی طریقے سے سمندری راستے کے ذریعے اسپین کے کینری جزائر اور دیگر یورپی علاقوں میں داخل ہونے کی کوشش کر رہے تھے۔

سینیگال کی وزارت داخلہ نے ابتدائی طور پر 21 لاشیں ملنے کی تصدیق کی تھی تاہم امدادی کارروائیوں کے بعد سرکاری خبر رساں ایجنسی اے پی ایس نے ہلاکتوں کی تعداد کم از کم 34 بتائی۔ بعد ازاں اتوار کی شب ہنگامی امدادی اداروں نے تصدیق کی کہ مرنے والوں کی تعداد بڑھ کر 35 ہو چکی ہے۔

حکام کا کہنا ہے کہ کشتی میں سوار افراد کی اصل تعداد کا اب تک تعین نہیں ہو سکا ہے اور لاپتا افراد کی تلاش کے لیے ریسکیو آپریشن جاری ہے۔ اس سانحے کے بعد ہلاکتوں میں مزید اضافے کا خدشہ بھی ظاہر کیا جا رہا ہے۔

stories.title: Historic Lahore Gurdwara Reopens for Worship After 79 Years
stories.summary:
A historical Sikh place of worship in Lahore has officially reopened its doors to the public on Sunday following an extensive restoration project. The Gurdwara Chhevin Patshahi Sri Guru Hargobind Sahib, located on Temple Road in the Mozang area, had remained closed since the 1947 Partition. A joint ceremony commemorating the reopening was organized by the Punjab government, the Evacuee Trust Property Board, and the Pakistan Sikh Gurdwara Parbandhak Committee. The event brought together numerous members of the Sikh community alongside notable figures, including Punjab minorities minister and PSGPC president Sardar Ramesh Singh Arora, ETPB Secretary Nasir Mushtaq, and other administrative officials.

The sacred site carries profound historical significance tied to Guru Hargobind, the sixth of Sikhism’s ten gurus, who lived from 1595 to 1644 and functioned as a warrior-saint to shield the community from religious persecution. Historical records indicate that Guru Hargobind accepted an invitation from local followers and spent three days residing at the home of a devotee named Bhai Jiwan in Mozang, which was then situated on the outskirts of Lahore. Deeply moved by hosting the religious leader, Bhai Jiwan transformed his dwelling into a gurdwara. Furthermore, the shrine is linked to Bhai Bidhi Chand, who famously visited Lahore twice to successfully recover two horses named Dilbagh and Gulbagh from the royal stables in the Lahore Fort after they had been seized by the Mughal governor.

Over the decades, the shrine underwent several structural expansions and administrative shifts. The local congregation enlarged the assembly hall in 1915, subsequently taking over management in 1921 following misconduct allegations against Mahant Hari Singh. A new building was erected in 1926 through the efforts of Sardar Mehar Singh, and the Shiromani Gurdwara Parbandhak Committee took control in 1927. The original structure itself dated back to the era of Maharaja Ranjit Singh, before regular worship ceased entirely due to the Partition.

Addressing attendees at the reopening ceremony, Minister Arora announced that the restored shrine is now fully operational for religious worship. He added that more than fifty gurdwaras across Pakistan are presently undergoing renovation as part of a broader initiative to protect Sikh religious heritage and assist visiting pilgrims. ETPB Secretary Nasir Mushtaq emphasized that safeguarding holy sites belonging to Sikh and Hindu communities remains a primary duty of the board. He also acknowledged the specific contributions of Giani Balwant Singh and committee member Professor Dr Mampal Singh toward successfully completing the restoration work.

stories.title: Oil Prices Slide After US President Rules Out New Iran Attacks
stories.summary:
Global oil prices dropped at Monday's open in Perth following remarks by United States President Donald Trump indicating that new attacks on Iran are highly unlikely while conflict resolution talks progress. Despite reports of maritime incidents near the Strait of Hormuz, Brent crude fell 84 cents, or 0.85%, to $97.48 per barrel by 0138 GMT, while West Texas Intermediate decreased by 32 cents, or 0.35%, to $90.51 a barrel. The decline counteracted minor gains from the prior Friday session, compounding a steep weekly drop of 17% for Brent.

President Trump stated in a phone interview with CNN that additional military action would depend on whether a strong agreement is signed, characterizing further strikes as unlikely. Market analysts, including KCM Trade chief analyst Tim Waterer, noted that while these comments appear measured, the market remains cautious about whether political developments mark a permanent shift in the US approach. Meanwhile, JPMorgan reported that recovering Middle Eastern supplies, increased external production, and sluggish demand are contributing to a prospective oil glut, projecting a surplus of 1.1 million barrels per day in September that will expand to 1.4 million bpd in October.

In related regional developments, Iraqi Foreign Minister Fuad Hussein announced on Sunday that Iraq has secured an understanding with the United States permitting oil exports through the Strait of Hormuz via an alternative shipping lane near Oman. Hussein noted that regional conflict disruptions and trade losses have cost Iraq $60 billion. Additionally, the Houthis claimed responsibility for a drone or missile strike on Saudi Aramco offices in Riyadh on Sunday, which resulted in blown-out windows but no reported casualties.

stories.title: Gold Prices Surge Over One Percent on Softer Oil and Dollar
stories.summary:
Gold prices increased by more than one percent on Monday, driven by declining oil prices and a weaker dollar that collectively reduced inflation concerns. Spot gold reached $4,123.46 per ounce, while US gold futures for December delivery also advanced 1.4% to $4,132.70 per ounce, following a weekly gain of approximately 5%. The downward movement in oil prices came after US President Donald Trump stated that further military attacks on Iran were highly unlikely while peace talks continue, thereby alleviating fears of potential supply disruptions. Market analysts note that lower oil costs diminish inflationary pressures and decrease expectations for prolonged high interest rates, which lowers the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding precious metals. Concurrently, a softer dollar made greenback-denominated bullion more affordable for international buyers.

At the same time, recent macroeconomic data showed US job growth accelerating in October and the unemployment rate dropping to 4.1%, signaling a resilient labor market. This robustness keeps the Federal Reserve on track for a potential interest-rate increase in December, with traders pricing an 81% probability for a rate hike according to CME's FedWatch tool, up from 71% prior to the payrolls report. Investors are now awaiting upcoming US Consumer Price Index figures on Tuesday and Producer Price Index data on Friday to gain further clarity on monetary policy direction. Analysts warn that stronger-than-expected inflation readings could strengthen the dollar and increase the likelihood of a December rate hike, potentially reversing recent gains for gold.

In addition to gold, other precious metals experienced notable upward momentum during the trading session. Spot silver climbed 2.5% to reach $53.15 per ounce, platinum recorded a 1.3% increase to land at $1,553.23 per ounce, and palladium rose 2.1% to reach $1,045.11 per ounce. The broader market reactions highlight how closely investors are monitoring geopolitical developments, currency fluctuations, and forthcoming domestic economic data to anticipate central bank actions.

stories.title: Ali Raza Replaces Injured Akif Javed in Pakistan Shaheens Squad
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) announced that fast bowler Ali Raza will step in to replace the injured Akif Javed in the Pakistan Shaheens squad. The team is preparing to compete in the upcoming ACC Rising Stars Asia Cup 2026, which is scheduled to take place in Qatar.

Akif Javed was ruled out of the tournament following medical assessments and MRI scans that confirmed a knee injury. The PCB medical team advised that he undergo a structured rehabilitation programme before returning to competitive cricket. This recovery plan includes strength and conditioning exercises, followed by a gradual return-to-play process and a graded bowling programme at the National Cricket Academy (NCA) under medical supervision.

Although Akif Javed had originally earned selection for the ACC tournament, the Selection Committee decided against taking any risks with the fast bowler's fitness, noting that he continues to experience pain. Given the high significance and competitive nature of the upcoming event, the committee recommended Ali Raza as the ideal replacement to join the squad.

The ACC Rising Stars Asia Cup 2026 represents an important international fixture for the Pakistan Shaheens as they field their developmental talent. The squad adjustments ensure that the team maintains fresh bowling depth while injured players focus entirely on their long-term recovery and rehabilitation pathways at the national level.

stories.title: کراچی میں دستاویزات کی بے ضابطگی پر غیر ملکی شپنگ ایجنسی جرمانہ
stories.summary:
ایف آئی اے امیگریشن نے کراچی پورٹ پر لنگر انداز ایک غیر ملکی بحری جہاز کے عملے کی دستاویزات میں سنگین بے ضابطگیاں ظاہر ہونے پر شپنگ ایجنسی پر 35 لاکھ روپے کا جرمانہ عائد کر دیا ہے۔ ترجمان ایف آئی اے کے مطابق جہاز CS MARAM ابوظہبی کے پرچم تلے صلالہ سے کراچی پہنچا تھا اور کیبل بچھانے کے منصوبے کے سلسلے میں تقریباً دو ماہ سے شہر میں موجود تھا۔

جہاز کی ویسٹ وارف برتھ نمبر 25 پر جانچ پڑتال کے دوران 33 رکنی عملے میں شامل 7 غیر ملکی کیٹرنگ ملازمین کی دستاویزات میں خامیاں پائی گئیں۔ ان ملازمین میں چار نیپالی، ایک بنگلہ دیشی اور دو ملاوی شہری شامل تھے جو کک اور اسٹیورڈ کے طور پر کام کر رہے تھے۔

انچارج حکام کے مطابق مذکورہ ملازمین کے پاس نیشنل سی مین بک، ٹریننگ سرٹیفکیٹس اور دیگر لازمی بحری دستاویزات موجود نہیں تھیں جبکہ کچھ ملازمین کے پاس برونڈی، پلاؤ اور سینٹ کٹس اینڈ نیوس کی سی مین بکس پائی گئیں۔ عملے کا مؤقف تھا کہ وہ پیشہ ور ملاح نہیں بلکہ مہمان نوازی کے فرائض انجام دے رہے ہیں اور یہ دستاویزات کمپنی نے فراہم کی تھیں۔

جہاز کے کپتان نے دستاویزات کی خامیوں کی ذمہ داری قبول کر لی جس پر شراف شپنگ پرائیویٹ لمیٹڈ کو 35 لاکھ روپے جرمانے کا نوٹس جاری کیا گیا۔ شپنگ ایجنٹ نے رقم قومی خزانے میں جمع کرا کے رسید امیگریشن آفس میں جمع کرانے کی یقین دہانی کرائی ہے۔

stories.title: Nvidia Investigates CEO Jensen Huang Amid Foreign Spying and Affair Allegations
stories.summary:
Nvidia announced on Monday that its board of directors is initiating an independent investigation to determine whether co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence operation. The inquiry follows recent media reports alleging that Huang maintained a close personal relationship with Alice Huang, an unrelated former executive of Megaspeed, a Singapore-based firm that purchases advanced Nvidia chips and has been investigated by US authorities as an alleged Chinese intelligence asset. US authorities have closely scrutinized Megaspeed over suspicions that it assisted Beijing in acquiring restricted, advanced artificial intelligence chips that are barred from shipment to China under export controls implemented since 2022. Nvidia stated that an independent committee of directors, assisted by outside legal counsel, will oversee the review, noting that the board currently has no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised.

In a message to employees, Jensen Huang admitted to being unfaithful to his wife and took full responsibility for his personal actions, stating that his behavior deeply hurt his family and that there was no excuse for what he did. Huang emphasized his commitment to protecting Nvidia and supporting US national security, while adding that he fully supports the board's review and is dedicated to cooperating with the inquiry. Nvidia leadership confirmed that the board has full confidence in Huang and his management team, and that the CEO will continue leading the company without interruption while the investigation proceeds. US President Donald Trump stated that he had not spoken with Huang about the allegations, describing him as an honorable person who has done an incredible job, while noting that the New York Times had reported he was briefed on the intelligence findings roughly a year ago and chose not to act.

These developments arrive at a delicate time for Nvidia, a $4.5 trillion chipmaker whose market valuation has faced severe pressure amid broader investor concerns regarding the sustainability of the artificial intelligence boom and high technology spending. As a central figure who has led the company for more than three decades and driven its dominance in AI hardware, Huang's position is critical to investor sentiment. Financial analysts warn that any potential removal or prolonged uncertainty regarding Huang's leadership could introduce substantial risks to the stock and trigger intense congressional scrutiny. Top Republican lawmakers in the US House of Representatives had already requested that Huang brief Congress regarding national security concerns surrounding sensitive US technology access, adding further regulatory and political weight to the ongoing controversy.

stories.title: لاہور میں پولیس نے کارروائی کرکے 13 سالہ بچی کی شادی رکوا دی
stories.summary:
لاہور کے علاقے میں پولیس نے ہیلپ لائن 15 پر موصول ہونے والی اطلاع پر بروقت کارروائی کرتے ہوئے کم عمر بچی کی شادی کی تقریب کو ناکام بنا دیا۔ پولیس نے اس کارروائی کے دوران دولہا سمیت کل چھ افراد کو حراست میں لے لیا ہے تاکہ قانون کی خلاف ورزی کرنے والوں کے خلاف سخت قدم اٹھایا جا سکے۔

یہ واقعہ مدینہ شادی ہال کشمیری محلہ میں پیش آیا جہاں تیرہ سالہ بچی کی رخصتی کی تقریب جاری تھی۔ پولیس حکام کے مطابق اس کارروائی کے دوران دولہا سبط الحسن اور لڑکی کے والد سبطین کے علاوہ تقریب میں موجود مزید چار افراد کو بھی گرفتار کر لیا گیا ہے۔

ابتدائی تحقیقات میں یہ بات سامنے آئی ہے کہ اس کم عمر بچی کا نکاح رواں سال چار اکتوبر کو پڑھایا گیا تھا، جبکہ اس کی رخصتی کی تقریب آٹھ نومبر کو رکھی گئی تھی۔ پولیس نے اس سلسلے میں ملزمان کے خلاف تھانہ لیاقت آباد میں مقدمہ نمبر 2533/26 درج کر کے مزید قانونی کارروائی اور تفتیش کا آغاز کر دیا ہے۔

ڈی آئی جی آپریشنز فیصل کامران نے اس موقع پر واضح کیا ہے کہ کم عمری کی شادی ایک سنگین قانونی جرم ہے اور اس معاملے میں بچوں کے تحفظ پر کسی قسم کا سمجھوتہ نہیں کیا جائے گا۔ انہوں نے عزم ظاہر کیا کہ بچوں کے حقوق کا تحفظ لاہور پولیس کی اولین ترجیح ہے اور ایسے جرائم میں ملوث تمام افراد کے خلاف قانون کے مطابق بلاامتیاز کارروائی کی جائے گی۔

stories.title: Pakistani Farmers Sue German Industrial Giants Over 2022 Flood Losses
stories.summary:
A group of 39 farmers from Pakistan's southern Sindh province are pursuing a climate lawsuit in Germany against German energy firm RWE and cement manufacturer Heidelberg Materials. The legal action seeks to hold major international industrial polluters financially accountable for the devastating climate impacts of the catastrophic floods that struck Pakistan in 2022.

The plaintiffs argue that the emissions generated by these two corporations contributed significantly to global climate change, which they contend supercharged the unprecedented monsoon rains. Those floods affected approximately 30 million people, killed 1,700 individuals, and submerged one-third of the country. Among the litigants is Abdul Hafeez Khoso from Jacobabad, who noted that the disaster wiped out homes, livestock, and crops, leaving families heavily indebted.

Supported by Pakistani and European organizations, including the HANDS Welfare Foundation, the lawsuit builds upon a legal precedent set last year when a German court left open the possibility of holding corporate emitters liable for climate damages. Lawyers representing the farmers assert that large companies have known about climate impacts since the 1960s and failed to exercise proper due diligence to reduce emissions. The plaintiffs estimate that RWE and Heidelberg Materials contributed roughly 0.68 percent and 0.12 percent of global industrial emissions, respectively.

Both targeted companies have strongly rejected the allegations, labeling the claims unfounded. Heidelberg Materials stated that its operations comply with German laws and that firms cannot retroactively face altered standards, while RWE described the lawsuit as an attempt to shift climate policy demands into German courtrooms.

Despite the significant legal hurdles and the likelihood that a civil process will take years, the farmers remain resolute in their pursuit of climate justice. Litigants like Munawar Khatoon and Abdul Khalique Laghari emphasized that the case represents an essential fight for accountability and survival for communities in a nation that contributes less than one percent of global emissions yet ranks among the most vulnerable to climate change.

stories.title: Pakistan National Football Team Welcomes Five Overseas Players for SAFF Cup Semifinals
stories.summary:
The Pakistan national football team is set to receive a significant boost ahead of the SAFF Championship semifinals in Dhaka on Wednesday. Five overseas-based players—Abdul Samad Shahzad, Ali Akbar Khan, Abdullah Iqbal, Easah Suliman, and Adil Nabi—are joining the squad after missing the group stage matches due to club commitments. Because the tournament took place outside the FIFA international window, their clubs were not obligated to release them earlier.

Pakistan kept their qualification hopes alive by defeating the Maldives 3-0 on Sunday, recovering from a narrow 3-2 opening loss to India in Group B. The team now awaits the outcome of the match between India and Maldives, where an Indian victory would secure Pakistan's progression to the knockout stage depending on final group standings. The arrival of these experienced expatriate players is expected to strengthen the squad significantly.

Meanwhile, tournament hosts Bangladesh are also bolstering their roster with overseas talent ahead of the semifinals. Sheffield United midfielder Hamza Choudhury arrived in Dhaka to join the squad, alongside expatriate forward Farhaan Ali Wahid. Bangladesh booked their semifinal spot following a draw between Sri Lanka and Bhutan, and they will face Sri Lanka in their final Group A fixture.

The semifinals of the regional tournament are scheduled for November 14, with the championship final to follow on November 17. Both Pakistan and Bangladesh hope that their newly arrived international players will provide the depth and quality needed to succeed in the final stages of the competition.

stories.title: ڈیرہ اسماعیل خان میں تیز رفتار ڈمپر کی ٹکر سے دو موٹرسائیکل سوار جاں بحق
stories.summary:
ڈیرہ اسماعیل خان کے قریب بھکر روڈ پر پیش آنے والے ایک ٹریفک حادثے میں تیز رفتار ڈمپر نے موٹرسائیکل کو کچل ڈالا، جس کے نتیجے میں دو افراد موقع پر ہی زندگی کی بازی ہار گئے۔ یہ ہولناک حادثہ اس وقت پیش آیا جب ایک بے قابو ڈمپر نے سڑک پر سفر کرنے والے موٹرسائیکل سواروں کو زور دار ٹکر مار دی، جو کہ ان کی ہجرت کا سبب بنی۔

حاصل ہونے والی تفصیلات کے مطابق یہ افسوسناک واقعہ بھکر روڈ پر حقہ فیکٹری کے قریب رونما ہوا۔ تیز رفتار ڈمپر کی زد میں آکر موٹرسائیکل پر سوار دونوں افراد شدید زخمی ہوئے اور موقع پر ہی دم توڑ گئے، جس کے بعد علاقے میں غم کی لہر دوڑ گئی۔

ریسکیو ذرائع اور حکام کی جانب سے جاں بحق ہونے والے دونوں افراد کی شناخت کر لی گئی ہے۔ ان کی شناخت مثل خان ولدیت حاجی مورا اور ملازم حسین سکنہ کچہ ملانہ کے ناموں سے ہوئی ہے، جن کے لواحقین کو اس حادثے کی اطلاع دے دی گئی ہے۔

یہ حادثہ تیز رفتار گاڑیوں کے بے لگام ہونے اور سڑکوں پر بڑھتے ہوئے خطرات کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔ مقامی انتظامیہ اور ٹریفک پولیس اس قسم کے حادثات کی روک تھام اور ڈرائیوروں کی غفلت کے خلاف مختلف اقدامات پر غور کر رہی ہے تاکہ مستقبل میں قیمتی جانوں کا ضیاع روکا جا سکے۔

stories.title: Coco Gauff Defeats Jessica Pegula in Grueling WTA Finals Group Match
stories.summary:
